introduction:
Introduction About MP 8MG TABLET

MP 8MG TABLET is used to manage various adrenal gland problems, including adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia, and nonsuppurative thyroiditis. It is also effective in managing autoimmune and inflammatory conditions affecting different parts of the body, such as rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, systemic lupus erythematosus, psoriasis, optic neuritis, uveitis, asthma, and certain blood disorders like leukemia. Additionally, it helps manage inflammatory bowel diseases like Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, as well as tuberculous meningitis in the brain.

This medication is also prescribed for managing severe allergic reactions, including drug-induced hypersensitivity, atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis, and allergic rhinitis. It can prevent graft rejection after organ transplantation and support kidney health by reducing protein loss in the urine or increasing urine output in conditions like nephrotic syndrome.

It contains a medicine called Methylprednisolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids.

Take MP 8MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Do not stop taking MP 8MG TABLET or reduce the dose of methylprednisolone without consulting your doctor as it may lead to unpleasant withdrawal symptoms, especially if you are taking higher dose of methylprednisolone.

Before taking MP 8MG TABLET inform your doctor if you any viral infections, or any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have hypertension, diabetes, thyroid deficiency, glaucoma, skin problem, gut inflammation, muscle problems, osteoporosis, any types of tumors or cancer in the body, depression or any other forms of mental illness.

It should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while taking MP 8MG TABLET as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of taking MP 8MG TABLET are high blood pressure, swelling of body parts, muscle cramps or weakness, skin thinning, feeling sad or depressed and slowed growth in children. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience severe depression with suicidal thoughts or severe stomach pain with blood-stained stools or vomit.

mechanismOfAction:
How MP 8MG TABLET Works

MP 8MG TABLET is a corticosteroid medicine with anti-inflammatory and immune suppressant properties. It boosts your body with sufficient corticosteroid levels (cortisol, aldosterone) during deficient conditions and helps your body to function properly.

It also reduces the release of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes inflammation. It manages graft rejection by suppressing the immune functions and protects your kidney from damage in patients with kidney problems.

introduction:
Introduction About DEPOPRED INJECTION

DEPOPRED INJECTION is used to manage various adrenal gland problems, including adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia, and nonsuppurative thyroiditis. It is also effective in managing autoimmune and inflammatory conditions affecting different parts of the body, such as rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, systemic lupus erythematosus, psoriasis, optic neuritis, uveitis, asthma, and certain blood disorders like leukemia. Additionally, it helps manage inflammatory bowel diseases like Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, as well as tuberculous meningitis in the brain.

This medication is also prescribed for managing severe allergic reactions, including drug-induced hypersensitivity, atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis, and allergic rhinitis. It can prevent graft rejection after organ transplantation and support kidney health by reducing protein loss in the urine or increasing urine output in conditions like nephrotic syndrome.

It contains Methylprednisolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids.

Before receiving DEPOPRED INJECTION inform your doctor if you any viral infections, or any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have hypertension, diabetes, thyroid deficiency, glaucoma, skin problem, gut inflammation, muscle problems, osteoporosis, any types of tumors or cancer in the body, depression or any other forms of mental illness.

DEPOPRED INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe fungal infections, brain swelling due to malaria, or brain injury or stroke. It should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while receiving DEPOPRED INJECTION as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of receiving DEPOPRED INJECTION are high blood pressure, swelling of body parts, muscle cramps or weakness, skin thinning, feeling sad or depressed and slowed growth in children. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience severe depression with suicidal thoughts or severe stomach pain with blood-stained stools or vomit after receiving it.

mechanismOfAction:
How DEPOPRED INJECTION Works

DEPOPRED INJECTION is a corticosteroid medicine with anti-inflammatory and immune suppressant properties. It boosts your body with sufficient corticosteroid levels (cortisol, aldosterone) during deficient conditions and helps your body to function properly.

It also reduces the release of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes pain, swelling and inflammation. It manages graft rejection by suppressing the immune functions and protects your kidney from damage in patients with kidney problems.

introduction:
Introduction About CORTIVAC 10 TABLET

CORTIVAC 10 TABLET contains Hydrocortisone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids. CORTIVAC 10 TABLET is used as a replacement therapy to replace insufficient adrenal hormone in the body that occurs due to inactive/underactive adrenal gland in affected individuals.

CORTIVAC 10 TABLET is also used to inhibit adrenocorticotropic hormone (chemical messenger responsible to regulate cortisol) when taken in combination with aminoglutethimide medicine for breast and prostate cancer. The medicine is also used to manage few types of illness and replace insufficient adrenal hormone after injury, surgery and/or other stressful events.

CORTIVAC 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to hydrocortisone, certain foods, preservatives and/or dyes. It is also not recommended for use in patients with fungal infections (such as thrush, candida) and in patients who recently received/scheduled (for) vaccinations.

Before taking CORTIVAC 10 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have/ever had severe depression, manic depression, septicaemia (life threatening infection), stomach ulcer, chicken pox/shingles, weakened immune system, high blood pressure, heart problems (such as heart attack, congestive heart disease), kidney and/or liver problems.

CORTIVAC 10 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is clearly necessary. It is also used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). The medicine can also be indicated for use in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The common side effect of taking CORTIVAC 10 TABLET is mental health problem. Consult your doctor if the symptom worsens.

How CORTIVAC 10 TABLET Works

Take CORTIVAC 10 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

CORTIVAC 10 TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy only if it is clearly necessary. Inform your doctor immediately if you get pregnant while taking this medicine. Consult your doctor before taking CORTIVAC 10 TABLET.

CORTIVAC 10 TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women only if it is necessary since the medicine may pass through breastmilk. Consult your doctor before taking CORTIVAC 10 TABLET.

Driving and Using Machines

Do not drive or operate machines if you experience extreme tiredness, short lasting dizziness, changes in eyesight (such as blurred vision) and/or muscle weakness after taking CORTIVAC 10 TABLET.

Kidney

CORTIVAC 10 TABLET should be used in caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before taking CORTIVAC 10 TABLET.

Liver

CORTIVAC 10 TABLET should be used in caution in patients with liver problems. Consult your doctor before taking CORTIVAC 10 TABLET.

Allergy

Do not take CORTIVAC 10 TABLET if you are allergic to hydrocortisone, certain foods, preservatives, dyes and/or any ingredients of this medicine.

Heart Disease

CORTIVAC 10 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart problems such as heart attack and congestive heart disease. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

introduction:
Introduction About ZEMPRED 16MG TABLET

ZEMPRED 16MG TABLET is used to manage various adrenal gland problems, including adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia, and nonsuppurative thyroiditis. It is also effective in managing autoimmune and inflammatory conditions affecting different parts of the body, such as rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, systemic lupus erythematosus, psoriasis, optic neuritis, uveitis, asthma, and certain blood disorders like leukemia. Additionally, it helps manage inflammatory bowel diseases like Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, as well as tuberculous meningitis in the brain.

This medication is also prescribed for managing severe allergic reactions, including drug-induced hypersensitivity, atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis, and allergic rhinitis. It can prevent graft rejection after organ transplantation and support kidney health by reducing protein loss in the urine or increasing urine output in conditions like nephrotic syndrome.

It contains a medicine called Methylprednisolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids.

Take ZEMPRED 16MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Do not stop taking ZEMPRED 16MG TABLET or reduce the dose of methylprednisolone without consulting your doctor as it may lead to unpleasant withdrawal symptoms, especially if you are taking higher dose of methylprednisolone.

Before taking ZEMPRED 16MG TABLET inform your doctor if you any viral infections, or any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have hypertension, diabetes, thyroid deficiency, glaucoma, skin problem, gut inflammation, muscle problems, osteoporosis, any types of tumors or cancer in the body, depression or any other forms of mental illness.

It should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while taking ZEMPRED 16MG TABLET as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of taking ZEMPRED 16MG TABLET are high blood pressure, swelling of body parts, muscle cramps or weakness, skin thinning, feeling sad or depressed and slowed growth in children. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience severe depression with suicidal thoughts or severe stomach pain with blood-stained stools or vomit.

mechanismOfAction:
How ZEMPRED 16MG TABLET Works

ZEMPRED 16MG TABLET is a corticosteroid medicine with anti-inflammatory and immune suppressant properties. It boosts your body with sufficient corticosteroid levels (cortisol, aldosterone) during deficient conditions and helps your body to function properly.

It also reduces the release of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes inflammation. It manages graft rejection by suppressing the immune functions and protects your kidney from damage in patients with kidney problems.

introduction:
Introduction About OVISTERONE SR PLUS TABLET

Ovisterone SR Plus Tablet is a hormone replacement therapy that is useful in improving the number of follicles, oocytes, implantation rates and high-quality embryos and reduces neural tube defects. It contains Dehydroepiandrosterone (DHEA), Vitamin D3, and Folic acid as the active ingredients which support female fertility and healthy pregnancy.

Dehydroepiandrosterone is involved in conception and fertilization and can increase the probability of conception and reduce miscarriages. Folic Acid manages birth defects associated with the baby’s brain. Vitamin D3 enhances adequate calcium absorption that is essential for the proper skeletal development of the baby, including healthy teeth and perhaps general foetal growth and development.

Always take Ovisterone SR Plus Tablet as advised by the physician. Swallow Ovisterone SR Plus Tablet with a glass of water, do not crush, chew, or break the tablet. Do not exceed the prescribed daily dosage.

introduction:
Introduction About TRICORT 4MG TABLET

TRICORT 4MG TABLET contains Triamcinolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids. It is used to reduce pain, inflammation and swelling associated with autoimmune skin disorders (Ex. contact dermatitis, eczema, psoriasis, etc.) and joints disorders (Ex. rheumatoid arthritis, gouty arthritis, osteoarthritis).

It can also be used in the management of allergic rhinitis, asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disorders (COPD). It may also be used as an adjunct therapy for adrenal insufficiency.

Take TRICORT 4MG TABLET with meals to avoid stomach upset. Before taking TRICORT 4MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension, thyroid problems, muscle problems, intestinal diseases, fungal or viral infections, fits, osteoporosis or any mental illnesses as a precaution.

Do not take TRICORT 4MG TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking TRICORT 4MG TABLET are stomach upset, vomiting, headache, dizziness, trouble sleeping, depression, acne, increased hair growth in the body and irregular or lack of menstrual periods. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience any unusual weight gain during therapy with TRICORT 4MG TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About HISONE 20MG TABLET

HISONE 20MG TABLET contains Hydrocortisone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids. HISONE 20MG TABLET is used as a replacement therapy to replace insufficient adrenal hormone in the body that occurs due to inactive/underactive adrenal gland in affected individuals.

HISONE 20MG TABLET is also used to inhibit adrenocorticotropic hormone (chemical messenger responsible to regulate cortisol) when taken in combination with aminoglutethimide medicine for breast and prostate cancer. The medicine is also used to manage few types of illness and replace insufficient adrenal hormone after injury, surgery and/or other stressful events.

HISONE 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to hydrocortisone, certain foods, preservatives and/or dyes. It is also not recommended for use in patients with fungal infections (such as thrush, candida) and in patients who recently received/scheduled (for) vaccinations.

Before taking HISONE 20MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have/ever had severe depression, manic depression, septicaemia (life threatening infection), stomach ulcer, chicken pox/shingles, weakened immune system, high blood pressure, heart problems (such as heart attack, congestive heart disease), kidney and/or liver problems.

HISONE 20MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is clearly necessary. It is also used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). The medicine can also be indicated for use in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The common side effect of taking HISONE 20MG TABLET is mental health problem. Consult your doctor if the symptom worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How HISONE 20MG TABLET Works

HISONE 20MG TABLET works by replacing insufficient cortisol (naturally produced steroid) levels and blocks the production of certain chemical messengers (responsible for inflammation and allergies) in the body which results in decreased swelling and providing relief from inflammation and pain in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use HISONE 20MG TABLET

Take HISONE 20MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ZEMPRED 4MG TABLET

ZEMPRED 4MG TABLET is used to manage various adrenal gland problems, including adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia, and nonsuppurative thyroiditis. It is also effective in managing autoimmune and inflammatory conditions affecting different parts of the body, such as rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, systemic lupus erythematosus, psoriasis, optic neuritis, uveitis, asthma, and certain blood disorders like leukemia. Additionally, it helps manage inflammatory bowel diseases like Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, as well as tuberculous meningitis in the brain.

This medication is also prescribed for managing severe allergic reactions, including drug-induced hypersensitivity, atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis, and allergic rhinitis. It can prevent graft rejection after organ transplantation and support kidney health by reducing protein loss in the urine or increasing urine output in conditions like nephrotic syndrome.

It contains a medicine called Methylprednisolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids.

Take ZEMPRED 4MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Do not stop taking ZEMPRED 4MG TABLET or reduce the dose of methylprednisolone without consulting your doctor as it may lead to unpleasant withdrawal symptoms, especially if you are taking higher dose of methylprednisolone.

Before taking ZEMPRED 4MG TABLET inform your doctor if you any viral infections, or any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have hypertension, diabetes, thyroid deficiency, glaucoma, skin problem, gut inflammation, muscle problems, osteoporosis, any types of tumors or cancer in the body, depression or any other forms of mental illness.

It should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while taking ZEMPRED 4MG TABLET as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of taking ZEMPRED 4MG TABLET are high blood pressure, swelling of body parts, muscle cramps or weakness, skin thinning, feeling sad or depressed and slowed growth in children. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience severe depression with suicidal thoughts or severe stomach pain with blood-stained stools or vomit.

mechanismOfAction:
How ZEMPRED 4MG TABLET Works

ZEMPRED 4MG TABLET is a corticosteroid medicine with anti-inflammatory and immune suppressant properties. It boosts your body with sufficient corticosteroid levels (cortisol, aldosterone) during deficient conditions and helps your body to function properly.

It also reduces the release of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes inflammation. It manages graft rejection by suppressing the immune functions and protects your kidney from damage in patients with kidney problems.

introduction:
Introduction About MACPRED 8MG TABLET

MACPRED 8MG TABLET is used to manage various adrenal gland problems, including adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia, and nonsuppurative thyroiditis. It is also effective in managing autoimmune and inflammatory conditions affecting different parts of the body, such as rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, systemic lupus erythematosus, psoriasis, optic neuritis, uveitis, asthma, and certain blood disorders like leukemia. Additionally, it helps manage inflammatory bowel diseases like Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, as well as tuberculous meningitis in the brain.

This medication is also prescribed for managing severe allergic reactions, including drug-induced hypersensitivity, atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis, and allergic rhinitis. It can prevent graft rejection after organ transplantation and support kidney health by reducing protein loss in the urine or increasing urine output in conditions like nephrotic syndrome.

It contains a medicine called Methylprednisolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids.

Take MACPRED 8MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Do not stop taking MACPRED 8MG TABLET or reduce the dose of methylprednisolone without consulting your doctor as it may lead to unpleasant withdrawal symptoms, especially if you are taking higher dose of methylprednisolone.

Before taking MACPRED 8MG TABLET inform your doctor if you any viral infections, or any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have hypertension, diabetes, thyroid deficiency, glaucoma, skin problem, gut inflammation, muscle problems, osteoporosis, any types of tumors or cancer in the body, depression or any other forms of mental illness.

It should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while taking MACPRED 8MG TABLET as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of taking MACPRED 8MG TABLET are high blood pressure, swelling of body parts, muscle cramps or weakness, skin thinning, feeling sad or depressed and slowed growth in children. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience severe depression with suicidal thoughts or severe stomach pain with blood-stained stools or vomit.

mechanismOfAction:
How MACPRED 8MG TABLET Works

MACPRED 8MG TABLET is a corticosteroid medicine with anti-inflammatory and immune suppressant properties. It boosts your body with sufficient corticosteroid levels (cortisol, aldosterone) during deficient conditions and helps your body to function properly.

It also reduces the release of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes inflammation. It manages graft rejection by suppressing the immune functions and protects your kidney from damage in patients with kidney problems.

introduction:
Introduction About STERIO 8MG TABLET

STERIO 8MG TABLET is used to manage various adrenal gland problems, including adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia, and nonsuppurative thyroiditis. It is also effective in managing autoimmune and inflammatory conditions affecting different parts of the body, such as rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, systemic lupus erythematosus, psoriasis, optic neuritis, uveitis, asthma, and certain blood disorders like leukemia. Additionally, it helps manage inflammatory bowel diseases like Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, as well as tuberculous meningitis in the brain.

This medication is also prescribed for managing severe allergic reactions, including drug-induced hypersensitivity, atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis, and allergic rhinitis. It can prevent graft rejection after organ transplantation and support kidney health by reducing protein loss in the urine or increasing urine output in conditions like nephrotic syndrome.

It contains a medicine called Methylprednisolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids.

Take STERIO 8MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Do not stop taking STERIO 8MG TABLET or reduce the dose of methylprednisolone without consulting your doctor as it may lead to unpleasant withdrawal symptoms, especially if you are taking higher dose of methylprednisolone.

Before taking STERIO 8MG TABLET inform your doctor if you any viral infections, or any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have hypertension, diabetes, thyroid deficiency, glaucoma, skin problem, gut inflammation, muscle problems, osteoporosis, any types of tumors or cancer in the body, depression or any other forms of mental illness.

It should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while taking STERIO 8MG TABLET as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of taking STERIO 8MG TABLET are high blood pressure, swelling of body parts, muscle cramps or weakness, skin thinning, feeling sad or depressed and slowed growth in children. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience severe depression with suicidal thoughts or severe stomach pain with blood-stained stools or vomit.

mechanismOfAction:
How STERIO 8MG TABLET Works

STERIO 8MG TABLET is a corticosteroid medicine with anti-inflammatory and immune suppressant properties. It boosts your body with sufficient corticosteroid levels (cortisol, aldosterone) during deficient conditions and helps your body to function properly.

It also reduces the release of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes inflammation. It manages graft rejection by suppressing the immune functions and protects your kidney from damage in patients with kidney problems.

Have fits

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before taking STERIO 8MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines such as:

Acetazolamide (a medicine used to manage glaucoma or edema)
Aminoglutethimide or cyclophosphamide (used for managing cancer)
Anticoagulants (used for blood thinning) such as acenocoumarol, phenindione and warfarin
Anti-cholinergic medicines used to manage myasthenia gravis (such as distigmine and neostigmine)
Antibacterials (Ex. isoniazid, erythromycin, clarithromycin and troleandomycin)
Anti diabetics (Ex. metformin, glipizide)
Aprepitant or fosaprepitant (antiemitics)
Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory medicines (used for fever and pain relief) such as aspirin, ibuprofen
Antiepileptics (such as carbamazepine, phenytoin and primidone)
Carbenoxolone and cimetidine (antiulcer agents)
Ciclosporin, tacrolimus (immunosuppressants)
Cardiovascular agents (such as digoxin, diltiazem or mibefradil)
Oral contraceptives (birth control pills) Ex. ethinylestridiol and norethisterone
Medicines used to manage HIV infection (such as ritonavir, indinavir, cobicistat)
Antifungals (such as ketoconazole, amphotericin B, itraconazole)
Muscle relaxants (Ex. pancuronium or vecuronium)
Diuretics (used to manage edema and hypertension) Ex. furosemide, chlorothiazide, hydrochlorothiazide
Medicines used to manage asthma (such as aminophylline, salmeterol, formoterol)
Rifampicin and rifabutin (Antituberculosis)
Live vaccines

B. Drug - Food interaction:

Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while taking STERIO 8MG TABLET as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took more STERIO 8MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital straight away.

introduction:
Introduction About WALACORT TABLET

WALACORT TABLET contains Betamethasone, which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids. It is used to manage many different types of conditions, including asthma and severe allergic reactions, certain conditions of the blood, rheumatoid arthritis (chronic inflammatory diseases affecting the joints), autoimmune diseases (like systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) and polyarteritis nodosa), inflammatory conditions of the skin, kidney (like acute interstitial nephritis), bowels (like ulcerative colitis and Crohn's disease) and heart, some connective tissue disorders and malignant lymphoma. WALACORT TABLET also help to manage organ transplant rejection following organ transplant surgery.

Your doctor might recommend you take relevant tests to understand your condition before starting management with WALACORT TABLET. Avoid drinking alcohol while using WALACORT TABLET as it may worsen your existing condition.

WALACORT TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with an infection and who are not taking antibiotics. Before taking WALACORT TABLET, inform your doctor if you have kidney, liver, heart problems, underactive thyroid gland, severe mental illness, tuberculosis, epilepsy, hypertension, pheochromocytoma, glaucoma, or diabetes.

WALACORT TABLET should be used with caution among women who are pregnant or breastfeeding. WALACORT TABLET should be used with caution in children, adolescents, and elderly patients. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen. Consult with your doctor if you experience any unusual behaviors, self-harming or depression, etc. after taking WALACORT TABLET.

How WALACORT TABLET Works

WALACORT TABLET inhibits certain chemical pathways in the body which reduces the formation of substances (arachidonic acid) that causes pain. It also enhances anti-inflammatory genes like interleukin 10. Thus, it helps in reducing pain and inflammation.

introduction:
Introduction About PREDMET 16MG TABLET

PREDMET 16MG TABLET is used to manage various adrenal gland problems, including adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia, and nonsuppurative thyroiditis. It is also effective in managing autoimmune and inflammatory conditions affecting different parts of the body, such as rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, systemic lupus erythematosus, psoriasis, optic neuritis, uveitis, asthma, and certain blood disorders like leukemia. Additionally, it helps manage inflammatory bowel diseases like Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, as well as tuberculous meningitis in the brain.

This medication is also prescribed for managing severe allergic reactions, including drug-induced hypersensitivity, atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis, and allergic rhinitis. It can prevent graft rejection after organ transplantation and support kidney health by reducing protein loss in the urine or increasing urine output in conditions like nephrotic syndrome.

It contains a medicine called Methylprednisolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids.

Take PREDMET 16MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Do not stop taking PREDMET 16MG TABLET or reduce the dose of methylprednisolone without consulting your doctor as it may lead to unpleasant withdrawal symptoms, especially if you are taking higher dose of methylprednisolone.

Before taking PREDMET 16MG TABLET inform your doctor if you any viral infections, or any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have hypertension, diabetes, thyroid deficiency, glaucoma, skin problem, gut inflammation, muscle problems, osteoporosis, any types of tumors or cancer in the body, depression or any other forms of mental illness.

It should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while taking PREDMET 16MG TABLET as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of taking PREDMET 16MG TABLET are high blood pressure, swelling of body parts, muscle cramps or weakness, skin thinning, feeling sad or depressed and slowed growth in children. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience severe depression with suicidal thoughts or severe stomach pain with blood-stained stools or vomit.

mechanismOfAction:
How PREDMET 16MG TABLET Works

PREDMET 16MG TABLET is a corticosteroid medicine with anti-inflammatory and immune suppressant properties. It boosts your body with sufficient corticosteroid levels (cortisol, aldosterone) during deficient conditions and helps your body to function properly.

It also reduces the release of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes inflammation. It manages graft rejection by suppressing the immune functions and protects your kidney from damage in patients with kidney problems.

introduction:
Introduction About NUCORT M 8MG TABLET

NUCORT M 8MG TABLET is used to manage various adrenal gland problems, including adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia, and nonsuppurative thyroiditis. It is also effective in managing autoimmune and inflammatory conditions affecting different parts of the body, such as rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, systemic lupus erythematosus, psoriasis, optic neuritis, uveitis, asthma, and certain blood disorders like leukemia. Additionally, it helps manage inflammatory bowel diseases like Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, as well as tuberculous meningitis in the brain.

This medication is also prescribed for managing severe allergic reactions, including drug-induced hypersensitivity, atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis, and allergic rhinitis. It can prevent graft rejection after organ transplantation and support kidney health by reducing protein loss in the urine or increasing urine output in conditions like nephrotic syndrome.

It contains a medicine called Methylprednisolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids.

Take NUCORT M 8MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Do not stop taking NUCORT M 8MG TABLET or reduce the dose of methylprednisolone without consulting your doctor as it may lead to unpleasant withdrawal symptoms, especially if you are taking higher dose of methylprednisolone.

Before taking NUCORT M 8MG TABLET inform your doctor if you any viral infections, or any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have hypertension, diabetes, thyroid deficiency, glaucoma, skin problem, gut inflammation, muscle problems, osteoporosis, any types of tumors or cancer in the body, depression or any other forms of mental illness.

It should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while taking NUCORT M 8MG TABLET as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of taking NUCORT M 8MG TABLET are high blood pressure, swelling of body parts, muscle cramps or weakness, skin thinning, feeling sad or depressed and slowed growth in children. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience severe depression with suicidal thoughts or severe stomach pain with blood-stained stools or vomit.

mechanismOfAction:
How NUCORT M 8MG TABLET Works

NUCORT M 8MG TABLET is a corticosteroid medicine with anti-inflammatory and immune suppressant properties. It boosts your body with sufficient corticosteroid levels (cortisol, aldosterone) during deficient conditions and helps your body to function properly.

It also reduces the release of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes inflammation. It manages graft rejection by suppressing the immune functions and protects your kidney from damage in patients with kidney problems.

Introduction About DEXONA INJECTION

DEXONA INJECTION contains Dexamethasone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids. It is used to manage problematic conditions of the adrenal glands (such as adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia and nonsuppurative thyroiditis)

It can also be used to manage various inflammatory auto-immune disease conditions affecting the bones and joints (Ex. rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis), skin and collagen (Ex. Stevens-Johnson syndrome, psoriasis), eyes (Ex. optic neuritis, uveitis or iritis), respiratory tract (Ex. asthma, pneumonitis, tuberculosis), blood and lymph (Ex. leukaemia, anemia, thrombocytopenia, blood cancer, lymph cancer, sarcoidosis), bowel and gut (Ex. Crohn’s disease and ulcerative colitis), brain (Ex. tuberculous meningitis, cerebral edema associated with brain tumor, increased pressure within the skull) and heart (inflammation of heart membranes)

It is also indicated in the management of drug induced hypersensitivity reactions and in other allergic reactions (such as atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis and allergic rhinitis). It also corrects calcium levels among cancer patients and increases urine output or reduces protein loss via urine among patients having kidney problems (such as nephrotic syndrome).

Before receiving DEXONA INJECTION inform your doctor if you any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension, glaucoma, epilepsy, underactive thyroid, muscle problems, osteoporosis, stomach problems, tuberculosis, depression, mania or any other mental problems as a precaution.

DEXONA INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with serious unmanageed infections in the body or bone problems. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women.

The most common side effects of receiving DEXONA INJECTION are headache, dizziness, acne, stomach discomfort, slow wound healing, skin thinning, high blood pressure, fluid retention, swelling and weight gain of the body and face, high blood sugar levels, muscle weakness, bone thinning and irregular menstrual periods. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About KENACORT 4MG TABLET

KENACORT 4MG TABLET contains Triamcinolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids. It is used to reduce pain, inflammation and swelling associated with autoimmune skin disorders (Ex. contact dermatitis, eczema, psoriasis, etc.) and joints disorders (Ex. rheumatoid arthritis, gouty arthritis, osteoarthritis).

It can also be used in the management of allergic rhinitis, asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disorders (COPD). It may also be used as an adjunct therapy for adrenal insufficiency.

Take KENACORT 4MG TABLET with meals to avoid stomach upset. Before taking KENACORT 4MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension, thyroid problems, muscle problems, intestinal diseases, fungal or viral infections, fits, osteoporosis or any mental illnesses as a precaution.

Do not take KENACORT 4MG TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking KENACORT 4MG TABLET are stomach upset, vomiting, headache, dizziness, trouble sleeping, depression, acne, increased hair growth in the body and irregular or lack of menstrual periods. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience any unusual weight gain during therapy with KENACORT 4MG TABLET.

How KENACORT 4MG TABLET Works

KENACORT 4MG TABLET is a steroid medication. It acts by suppressing the release if certain chemicals in the body that causes pain, inflammation and swelling. It also supresses the release of certain inflammatory mediators in the airways that causes swelling and narrowing. As a result, it reduces inflammation and swelling caused due to allergic and auto-immune disease conditions.

Take KENACORT 4MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. KENACORT 4MG TABLET should be taken with meals.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About IVEPRED 8MG TABLET

IVEPRED 8MG TABLET is used to manage various adrenal gland problems, including adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia, and nonsuppurative thyroiditis. It is also effective in managing autoimmune and inflammatory conditions affecting different parts of the body, such as rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, systemic lupus erythematosus, psoriasis, optic neuritis, uveitis, asthma, and certain blood disorders like leukemia. Additionally, it helps manage inflammatory bowel diseases like Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, as well as tuberculous meningitis in the brain.

This medication is also prescribed for managing severe allergic reactions, including drug-induced hypersensitivity, atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis, and allergic rhinitis. It can prevent graft rejection after organ transplantation and support kidney health by reducing protein loss in the urine or increasing urine output in conditions like nephrotic syndrome.

It contains a medicine called Methylprednisolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids.

Take IVEPRED 8MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Do not stop taking IVEPRED 8MG TABLET or reduce the dose of methylprednisolone without consulting your doctor as it may lead to unpleasant withdrawal symptoms, especially if you are taking higher dose of methylprednisolone.

Before taking IVEPRED 8MG TABLET inform your doctor if you any viral infections, or any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have hypertension, diabetes, thyroid deficiency, glaucoma, skin problem, gut inflammation, muscle problems, osteoporosis, any types of tumors or cancer in the body, depression or any other forms of mental illness.

It should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while taking IVEPRED 8MG TABLET as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of taking IVEPRED 8MG TABLET are high blood pressure, swelling of body parts, muscle cramps or weakness, skin thinning, feeling sad or depressed and slowed growth in children. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience severe depression with suicidal thoughts or severe stomach pain with blood-stained stools or vomit.

introduction:
Introduction About MACPRED 16MG TABLET

MACPRED 16MG TABLET is used to manage various adrenal gland problems, including adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia, and nonsuppurative thyroiditis. It is also effective in managing autoimmune and inflammatory conditions affecting different parts of the body, such as rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, systemic lupus erythematosus, psoriasis, optic neuritis, uveitis, asthma, and certain blood disorders like leukemia. Additionally, it helps manage inflammatory bowel diseases like Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, as well as tuberculous meningitis in the brain.

This medication is also prescribed for managing severe allergic reactions, including drug-induced hypersensitivity, atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis, and allergic rhinitis. It can prevent graft rejection after organ transplantation and support kidney health by reducing protein loss in the urine or increasing urine output in conditions like nephrotic syndrome.

It contains a medicine called Methylprednisolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids.

Take MACPRED 16MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Do not stop taking MACPRED 16MG TABLET or reduce the dose of methylprednisolone without consulting your doctor as it may lead to unpleasant withdrawal symptoms, especially if you are taking higher dose of methylprednisolone.

Before taking MACPRED 16MG TABLET inform your doctor if you any viral infections, or any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have hypertension, diabetes, thyroid deficiency, glaucoma, skin problem, gut inflammation, muscle problems, osteoporosis, any types of tumors or cancer in the body, depression or any other forms of mental illness.

It should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while taking MACPRED 16MG TABLET as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of taking MACPRED 16MG TABLET are high blood pressure, swelling of body parts, muscle cramps or weakness, skin thinning, feeling sad or depressed and slowed growth in children. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience severe depression with suicidal thoughts or severe stomach pain with blood-stained stools or vomit.

mechanismOfAction:
How MACPRED 16MG TABLET Works

MACPRED 16MG TABLET is a corticosteroid medicine with anti-inflammatory and immune suppressant properties. It boosts your body with sufficient corticosteroid levels (cortisol, aldosterone) during deficient conditions and helps your body to function properly.

It also reduces the release of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes inflammation. It manages graft rejection by suppressing the immune functions and protects your kidney from damage in patients with kidney problems.

Interactions

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before taking STERIO 16MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines such as:

Acetazolamide (a medicine used to manage glaucoma or edema)
Aminoglutethimide or cyclophosphamide (used for managing cancer)
Anticoagulants (used for blood thinning) such as acenocoumarol, phenindione and warfarin
Anti-cholinergic medicines used to manage myasthenia gravis (such as distigmine and neostigmine)
Antibacterials (Ex. isoniazid, erythromycin, clarithromycin and troleandomycin)
Anti diabetics (Ex. metformin, glipizide)
Aprepitant or fosaprepitant (antiemitics)
Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory medicines (used for fever and pain relief) such as aspirin, ibuprofen
Antiepileptics (such as carbamazepine, phenytoin and primidone)
Carbenoxolone and cimetidine (antiulcer agents)
Ciclosporin, tacrolimus (immunosuppressants)
Cardiovascular agents (such as digoxin, diltiazem or mibefradil)
Oral contraceptives (birth control pills) Ex. ethinylestridiol and norethisterone
Medicines used to manage HIV infection (such as ritonavir, indinavir, cobicistat)
Antifungals (such as ketoconazole, amphotericin B, itraconazole)
Muscle relaxants (Ex. pancuronium or vecuronium)
Diuretics (used to manage edema and hypertension) Ex. furosemide, chlorothiazide, hydrochlorothiazide
Medicines used to manage asthma (such as aminophylline, salmeterol, formoterol)

Live vaccines

Introduction About METHYLCORTIL 4MG TABLET

METHYLCORTIL 4MG TABLET is used to manage various adrenal gland problems, including adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia, and nonsuppurative thyroiditis. It is also effective in managing autoimmune and inflammatory conditions affecting different parts of the body, such as rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, systemic lupus erythematosus, psoriasis, optic neuritis, uveitis, asthma, and certain blood disorders like leukemia. Additionally, it helps manage inflammatory bowel diseases like Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, as well as tuberculous meningitis in the brain.

This medication is also prescribed for managing severe allergic reactions, including drug-induced hypersensitivity, atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis, and allergic rhinitis. It can prevent graft rejection after organ transplantation and support kidney health by reducing protein loss in the urine or increasing urine output in conditions like nephrotic syndrome.

It contains a medicine called Methylprednisolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids.

Take METHYLCORTIL 4MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Do not stop taking METHYLCORTIL 4MG TABLET or reduce the dose of methylprednisolone without consulting your doctor as it may lead to unpleasant withdrawal symptoms, especially if you are taking higher dose of methylprednisolone.

Before taking METHYLCORTIL 4MG TABLET inform your doctor if you any viral infections, or any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have hypertension, diabetes, thyroid deficiency, glaucoma, skin problem, gut inflammation, muscle problems, osteoporosis, any types of tumors or cancer in the body, depression or any other forms of mental illness.

It should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while taking METHYLCORTIL 4MG TABLET as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of taking METHYLCORTIL 4MG TABLET are high blood pressure, swelling of body parts, muscle cramps or weakness, skin thinning, feeling sad or depressed and slowed growth in children. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience severe depression with suicidal thoughts or severe stomach pain with blood-stained stools or vomit.

Introduction About PREDMET 8 TABLET

PREDMET 8 TABLET is used to manage various adrenal gland problems, including adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia, and nonsuppurative thyroiditis. It is also effective in managing autoimmune and inflammatory conditions affecting different parts of the body, such as rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, systemic lupus erythematosus, psoriasis, optic neuritis, uveitis, asthma, and certain blood disorders like leukemia. Additionally, it helps manage inflammatory bowel diseases like Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, as well as tuberculous meningitis in the brain.

This medication is also prescribed for managing severe allergic reactions, including drug-induced hypersensitivity, atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis, and allergic rhinitis. It can prevent graft rejection after organ transplantation and support kidney health by reducing protein loss in the urine or increasing urine output in conditions like nephrotic syndrome.

It contains a medicine called Methylprednisolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids.

Take PREDMET 8 TABLET as advised by your physician. Do not stop taking PREDMET 8 TABLET or reduce the dose of methylprednisolone without consulting your doctor as it may lead to unpleasant withdrawal symptoms, especially if you are taking higher dose of methylprednisolone.

Before taking PREDMET 8 TABLET inform your doctor if you any viral infections, or any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have hypertension, diabetes, thyroid deficiency, glaucoma, skin problem, gut inflammation, muscle problems, osteoporosis, any types of tumors or cancer in the body, depression or any other forms of mental illness.

It should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while taking PREDMET 8 TABLET as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of taking PREDMET 8 TABLET are high blood pressure, swelling of body parts, muscle cramps or weakness, skin thinning, feeling sad or depressed and slowed growth in children. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience severe depression with suicidal thoughts or severe stomach pain with blood-stained stools or vomit.

mechanismOfAction:
How PREDMET 8 TABLET Works

PREDMET 8 TABLET is a corticosteroid medicine with anti-inflammatory and immune suppressant properties. It boosts your body with sufficient corticosteroid levels (cortisol, aldosterone) during deficient conditions and helps your body to function properly.

It also reduces the release of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes inflammation. It manages graft rejection by suppressing the immune functions and protects your kidney from damage in patients with kidney problems.

introduction:
Introduction About IVEPRED 1GM INJECTION

IVEPRED 1GM INJECTION is used to manage various adrenal gland problems, including adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia, and nonsuppurative thyroiditis. It is also effective in managing autoimmune and inflammatory conditions affecting different parts of the body, such as rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, systemic lupus erythematosus, psoriasis, optic neuritis, uveitis, asthma, and certain blood disorders like leukemia. Additionally, it helps manage inflammatory bowel diseases like Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, as well as tuberculous meningitis in the brain.

This medication is also prescribed for managing severe allergic reactions, including drug-induced hypersensitivity, atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis, and allergic rhinitis. It can prevent graft rejection after organ transplantation and support kidney health by reducing protein loss in the urine or increasing urine output in conditions like nephrotic syndrome.

It contains Methylprednisolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids.

Before receiving IVEPRED 1GM INJECTION inform your doctor if you any viral infections, or any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have hypertension, diabetes, thyroid deficiency, glaucoma, skin problem, gut inflammation, muscle problems, osteoporosis, any types of tumors or cancer in the body, depression or any other forms of mental illness.

IVEPRED 1GM INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe fungal infections, brain swelling due to malaria, or brain injury or stroke. It should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while receiving IVEPRED 1GM INJECTION as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of receiving IVEPRED 1GM INJECTION are high blood pressure, swelling of body parts, muscle cramps or weakness, skin thinning, feeling sad or depressed and slowed growth in children. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience severe depression with suicidal thoughts or severe stomach pain with blood-stained stools or vomit after receiving it.

mechanismOfAction:
How IVEPRED 1GM INJECTION Works

IVEPRED 1GM INJECTION is a corticosteroid medicine with anti-inflammatory and immune suppressant properties. It boosts your body with sufficient corticosteroid levels (cortisol, aldosterone) during deficient conditions and helps your body to function properly.

It also reduces the release of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes pain, swelling and inflammation. It manages graft rejection by suppressing the immune functions and protects your kidney from damage in patients with kidney problems.

IVEPRED 1GM INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the muscle (intramuscularly) or into the vein (intravenously). Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About PRIMACORT 100MG INJECTION

PRIMACORT 100MG INJECTION contains Hydrocortisone, which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids. PRIMACORT 100MG INJECTION is used to manage endocrine disorders (diseases of endocrine glands), rheumatic disorders (inflammatory and autoimmune diseases), and hematologic disorders (blood disorders) in affected individuals.

It is also used to manage collagen diseases (autoimmune disease), dermatologic diseases, ophthalmic diseases, gastrointestinal diseases, respiratory diseases, and neoplastic diseases. The medicine is also indicated for use to replace insufficient corticosteroid hormone and manage edematous and allergic states and medical emergencies (such as shock or severe allergic reactions) in affected individuals.

PRIMACORT 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to hydrocortisone. It is also not recommended for use in patients with systemic fungal infections, viral infections (such as herpes simplex eye infection, vaccinia, varicella), and idiopathic thrombocytopenic purpura (a blood disorder marked by low platelet levels). The medicine is also not indicated for use in patients who have recently received live-attenuated vaccines.

Before receiving PRIMACORT 100MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have/have had an infection (such as herpes simplex, chickenpox, tuberculosis, threadworm), bleeding/clotting problem, suffering from osteoporosis (brittle bone), high blood pressure, oedema (swelling in arms/legs), diabetes, kidney problems (such as renal insufficiency), and/or liver problems (such as cirrhosis).

PRIMACORT 100MG INJECTION should be administered with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.

PRIMACORT 100MG INJECTION should be administered with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). If the medicine is to be received for a longer period of time, then frequent tests on the child need to be conducted to manage the risk of developing high intracranial pressure in the child. The medicine is advised to be administered with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects associated with the use of PRIMACORT 100MG INJECTION are pain and swelling at the site of injection. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

Manage endocrine disorders, rheumatic disorders, and hematologic disorders
Manage collagen diseases, dermatologic diseases, ophthalmic diseases, gastrointestinal diseases, respiratory diseases, and neoplastic diseases
Replaces insufficient corticosteroid hormone and manages edematous and allergic states and medical emergencies (such as shock or severe allergic reactions) in affected individuals
mechanismOfAction:
How PRIMACORT 100MG INJECTION Works

PRIMACORT 100MG INJECTION works by replacing insufficient cortisol (naturally produced steroid) levels and blocks the production of certain chemical messengers (responsible for inflammation and allergies) in the body, which results in decreased swelling and provides relief from inflammation and pain in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use PRIMACORT 100MG INJECTION

PRIMACORT 100MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous injection/infusion or into a muscle as an intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of PRIMACORT 100MG INJECTION for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

warnings.details: PRIMACORT 100MG INJECTION should be used with caution during pregnancy only if it is clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.

PRIMACORT 100MG INJECTION should be used with caution in breastfeeding women only if it is necessary since the medicine may pass through breastmilk. Consult your doctor before receiving PRIMACORT 100MG INJECTION.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience dizziness, vertigo (internal spinning sensation), visual disturbances, and/or tiredness after receiving PRIMACORT 100MG INJECTION.
PRIMACORT 100MG INJECTION should be received with caution in patients with kidney problems such as renal inefficiency. Consult your doctor before receiving PRIMACORT 100MG INJECTION.
PRIMACORT 100MG INJECTION should be received with caution in patients with liver disease such as cirrhosis. Consult your doctor before receiving PRIMACORT 100MG INJECTION.

Do not receive PRIMACORT 100MG INJECTION if you are allergic to hydrocortisone, any other corticosteroid medicine, and/or any other ingredients in the medicine. Consult a doctor before receiving PRIMACORT 100MG INJECTION.

PRIMACORT 100MG INJECTION should be received with caution in patients with heart disease such as heart failure, heart attack, and congestive heart disease. Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.

PRIMACORT 100MG INJECTION should be administered with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). If the medicine is to be received for a longer period, then frequent tests on the child need to be conducted to manage the risk of developing high intracranial pressure. If the medicine is administered to a premature baby, then few tests are conducted to monitor heart function. Consult your doctor before the child receives the medicine.
PRIMACORT 100MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Consult your doctor before receiving PRIMACORT 100MG INJECTION.

Others

PRIMACORT 100MG INJECTION is not recommended to receive if you:

Have systemic fungal infections
Are suffering from idiopathic thrombocytopenic purpura (blood disorder marked by low platelet levels)
Are administered with live attenuated vaccines
Are suffering from viral infections such as herpes simplex eye infection (a potentially serious type of eye infection), vaccinia, and varicella

Before receiving PRIMACORT 100MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Have/have had an infection (such as herpes simplex, chickenpox, tuberculosis, threadworm)
Have bleeding/clotting problem
Are suffering from osteoporosis (brittle bone)
Have high blood pressure
Have oedema (swelling in arms/legs)
Have diabetes
Have/had seizures (convulsions) and/or other neurological problems
Have thyroid problems
Suffer from signs of myasthenia gravis such as muscle pain, muscle weakness
Are suffering from retinal problems/certain eye diseases such as glaucoma, cataracts, and herpes infection (viral infection of the eye)
Have certain mental/mood conditions such as depression
Have/had stomach or gut problems such as ulcer or ulcerative colitis
Are suffering from low potassium/calcium levels in the blood
Have a weak immune response
Are scheduled for a surgery

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before receiving PRIMACORT 100MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Aspirin (used to reduce fever and relieve pain)
Amphotericin B (used to manage serious and potentially life-threatening fungal infections)
Isoniazid (used to manage or manage recurrence of tuberculosis)
Rifampicin (medicine used to manage tuberculosis)
Erythromycin, clarithromycin, and oleandomycin (medicines used to manage bacterial infections)
Anticoagulants (used to manage blood clots) Ex. rivaroxaban, dabigatran
Anticonvulsants (medicines used to manage seizures) Ex. carbamazepine
Barbiturates (sedative-hypnotic medication used to manage seizures) Ex. phenobarbital, phenytoin
Neuromuscular blockers (used in anesthesia to facilitate endotracheal intubation) Ex. rocuronium, vecuronium
Anticholinesterase (medicines used to manage Alzheimer disease) Ex. galantamine, donepezil
Antidiabetics (medicines used to manage diabetes) Ex. insulin, metformin
Antiemetics (medicines used to ease nausea and vomiting) Ex. aprepitant, fosaprepitant
Antifungals (medicines used to manage fungal infections) Ex. itraconazole, ketoconazole
HIV protease inhibitors (medicines used to manage HIV) Ex. atazanavir, darunavir 
Aromatase inhibitors (used to manage breast cancer) Ex. aminoglutethimide
Calcium channel blocker (used to manage low blood pressure) Ex. diltiazem
Cardiac glycosides (used to manage heart failure and irregular heartbeats) Ex. digoxin
Cholestyramine (used to lower high cholesterol levels in the blood)
Oral contraceptives (used to manage pregnancy) Ex. estrogens
Somatropin (used to manage growth failure)
Cyclosporine (used to manage organ transplant failure)
Immunosuppressant (used to stop your immune system from attacking health cells) Ex. cyclophosphamide, tacrolimus
Diuretics (used to manage low blood pressure) Ex. chlorothiazide, chlorthalidone
Beta2 agonists (used to manage asthma and COPD) Ex. salbutamol, terbutaline
Vaccines (used to boost the immune system) Ex. chickenpox vaccine

B. Drug-Food interaction:

Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking PRIMACORT 100MG INJECTION, as it may cause steroid toxicity.

Overdosage:

PRIMACORT 100MG INJECTION will be administered to you only by a doctor or a nurse in a hospital, and so you are unlikely to receive an overdose. However, consult your doctor or nurse if you experience any unusual symptoms.

introduction:
Introduction About METHONE 16MG TABLET

METHONE 16MG TABLET is used to manage various adrenal gland problems, including adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia, and nonsuppurative thyroiditis. It is also effective in managing autoimmune and inflammatory conditions affecting different parts of the body, such as rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, systemic lupus erythematosus, psoriasis, optic neuritis, uveitis, asthma, and certain blood disorders like leukemia. Additionally, it helps manage inflammatory bowel diseases like Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, as well as tuberculous meningitis in the brain.

This medication is also prescribed for managing severe allergic reactions, including drug-induced hypersensitivity, atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis, and allergic rhinitis. It can prevent graft rejection after organ transplantation and support kidney health by reducing protein loss in the urine or increasing urine output in conditions like nephrotic syndrome.

It contains a medicine called Methylprednisolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids.

Take METHONE 16MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Do not stop taking METHONE 16MG TABLET or reduce the dose of methylprednisolone without consulting your doctor as it may lead to unpleasant withdrawal symptoms, especially if you are taking higher dose of methylprednisolone.

Before taking METHONE 16MG TABLET inform your doctor if you any viral infections, or any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have hypertension, diabetes, thyroid deficiency, glaucoma, skin problem, gut inflammation, muscle problems, osteoporosis, any types of tumors or cancer in the body, depression or any other forms of mental illness.

It should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while taking METHONE 16MG TABLET as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of taking METHONE 16MG TABLET are high blood pressure, swelling of body parts, muscle cramps or weakness, skin thinning, feeling sad or depressed and slowed growth in children. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience severe depression with suicidal thoughts or severe stomach pain with blood-stained stools or vomit.

mechanismOfAction:
How METHONE 16MG TABLET Works

METHONE 16MG TABLET is a corticosteroid medicine with anti-inflammatory and immune suppressant properties. It boosts your body with sufficient corticosteroid levels (cortisol, aldosterone) during deficient conditions and helps your body to function properly.

It also reduces the release of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes inflammation. It manages graft rejection by suppressing the immune functions and protects your kidney from damage in patients with kidney problems.

Interactions

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before taking METHONE 16MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines such as:

Acetazolamide (a medicine used to manage glaucoma or edema)
Aminoglutethimide or cyclophosphamide (used for managing cancer)
Anticoagulants (used for blood thinning) such as acenocoumarol, phenindione and warfarin
Anti-cholinergic medicines used to manage myasthenia gravis (such as distigmine and neostigmine)
Antibacterials (Ex. isoniazid, erythromycin, clarithromycin and troleandomycin)
Anti diabetics (Ex. metformin, glipizide)
Aprepitant or fosaprepitant (antiemitics)
Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory medicines (used for fever and pain relief) such as aspirin, ibuprofen
Antiepileptics (such as carbamazepine, phenytoin and primidone)
Carbenoxolone and cimetidine (antiulcer agents)
Ciclosporin, tacrolimus (immunosuppressants)
Cardiovascular agents (such as digoxin, diltiazem or mibefradil)
Oral contraceptives (birth control pills) Ex. ethinylestridiol and norethisterone
Medicines used to manage HIV infection (such as ritonavir, indinavir, cobicistat)
Antifungals (such as ketoconazole, amphotericin B, itraconazole)
Muscle relaxants (Ex. pancuronium or vecuronium)
Diuretics (used to manage edema and hypertension) Ex. furosemide, chlorothiazide, hydrochlorothiazide

Live vaccines

Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while taking METHONE 16MG TABLET as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

Introduction About SOLU MEDROL 125MG INJECTION

SOLU MEDROL 125MG INJECTION is used to manage various adrenal gland problems, including adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia, and nonsuppurative thyroiditis. It is also effective in managing autoimmune and inflammatory conditions affecting different parts of the body, such as rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, systemic lupus erythematosus, psoriasis, optic neuritis, uveitis, asthma, and certain blood disorders like leukemia. Additionally, it helps manage inflammatory bowel diseases like Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, as well as tuberculous meningitis in the brain.

This medication is also prescribed for managing severe allergic reactions, including drug-induced hypersensitivity, atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis, and allergic rhinitis. It can prevent graft rejection after organ transplantation and support kidney health by reducing protein loss in the urine or increasing urine output in conditions like nephrotic syndrome.

It contains Methylprednisolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids.

Before receiving SOLU MEDROL 125MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you any viral infections, or any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have hypertension, diabetes, thyroid deficiency, glaucoma, skin problem, gut inflammation, muscle problems, osteoporosis, any types of tumors or cancer in the body, depression or any other forms of mental illness.

SOLU MEDROL 125MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe fungal infections, brain swelling due to malaria, or brain injury or stroke. It should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while receiving SOLU MEDROL 125MG INJECTION as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of receiving SOLU MEDROL 125MG INJECTION are high blood pressure, swelling of body parts, muscle cramps or weakness, skin thinning, feeling sad or depressed and slowed growth in children. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience severe depression with suicidal thoughts or severe stomach pain with blood-stained stools or vomit after receiving it.

mechanismOfAction:
How SOLU MEDROL 125MG INJECTION Works

SOLU MEDROL 125MG INJECTION is a corticosteroid medicine with anti-inflammatory and immune suppressant properties. It boosts your body with sufficient corticosteroid levels (cortisol, aldosterone) during deficient conditions and helps your body to function properly.

It also reduces the release of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes pain, swelling and inflammation. It manages graft rejection by suppressing the immune functions and protects your kidney from damage in patients with kidney problems.

introduction:
Introduction About PRIMACORT 200MG INJECTION

PRIMACORT 200MG INJECTION contains Hydrocortisone, which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids. PRIMACORT 200MG INJECTION is used to manage endocrine disorders (diseases of endocrine glands), rheumatic disorders (inflammatory and autoimmune diseases), and hematologic disorders (blood disorders) in affected individuals.

It is also used to manage collagen diseases (autoimmune disease), dermatologic diseases, ophthalmic diseases, gastrointestinal diseases, respiratory diseases, and neoplastic diseases. The medicine is also indicated for use to replace insufficient corticosteroid hormone and manage edematous and allergic states and medical emergencies (such as shock or severe allergic reactions) in affected individuals.

PRIMACORT 200MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to hydrocortisone. It is also not recommended for use in patients with systemic fungal infections, viral infections (such as herpes simplex eye infection, vaccinia, varicella), and idiopathic thrombocytopenic purpura (a blood disorder marked by low platelet levels). The medicine is also not indicated for use in patients who have recently received live-attenuated vaccines.

Before receiving PRIMACORT 200MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have/have had an infection (such as herpes simplex, chickenpox, tuberculosis, threadworm), bleeding/clotting problem, suffering from osteoporosis (brittle bone), high blood pressure, oedema (swelling in arms/legs), diabetes, kidney problems (such as renal insufficiency), and/or liver problems (such as cirrhosis).

PRIMACORT 200MG INJECTION should be administered with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.

PRIMACORT 200MG INJECTION should be administered with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). If the medicine is to be received for a longer period of time, then frequent tests on the child need to be conducted to manage the risk of developing high intracranial pressure in the child. The medicine is advised to be administered with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects associated with the use of PRIMACORT 200MG INJECTION are pain and swelling at the site of injection. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About RIOCORT 4MG TABLET

RIOCORT 4MG TABLET contains Triamcinolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids. It is used to reduce pain, inflammation and swelling associated with autoimmune skin disorders (Ex. contact dermatitis, eczema, psoriasis, etc.) and joints disorders (Ex. rheumatoid arthritis, gouty arthritis, osteoarthritis).

It can also be used in the management of allergic rhinitis, asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disorders (COPD). It may also be used as an adjunct therapy for adrenal insufficiency.

Take RIOCORT 4MG TABLET with meals to avoid stomach upset. Before taking RIOCORT 4MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension, thyroid problems, muscle problems, intestinal diseases, fungal or viral infections, fits, osteoporosis or any mental illnesses as a precaution.

Do not take RIOCORT 4MG TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking RIOCORT 4MG TABLET are stomach upset, vomiting, headache, dizziness, trouble sleeping, depression, acne, increased hair growth in the body and irregular or lack of menstrual periods. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience any unusual weight gain during therapy with RIOCORT 4MG TABLET.

How RIOCORT 4MG TABLET Works

RIOCORT 4MG TABLET is a steroid medication. It acts by suppressing the release if certain chemicals in the body that causes pain, inflammation and swelling. It also supresses the release of certain inflammatory mediators in the airways that causes swelling and narrowing. As a result, it reduces inflammation and swelling caused due to allergic and auto-immune disease conditions.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About PREDMET 4 TABLET

PREDMET 4 TABLET is used to manage various adrenal gland problems, including adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia, and nonsuppurative thyroiditis. It is also effective in managing autoimmune and inflammatory conditions affecting different parts of the body, such as rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, systemic lupus erythematosus, psoriasis, optic neuritis, uveitis, asthma, and certain blood disorders like leukemia. Additionally, it helps manage inflammatory bowel diseases like Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, as well as tuberculous meningitis in the brain.

This medication is also prescribed for managing severe allergic reactions, including drug-induced hypersensitivity, atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis, and allergic rhinitis. It can prevent graft rejection after organ transplantation and support kidney health by reducing protein loss in the urine or increasing urine output in conditions like nephrotic syndrome.

It contains a medicine called Methylprednisolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids.

Take PREDMET 4 TABLET as advised by your physician. Do not stop taking PREDMET 4 TABLET or reduce the dose of methylprednisolone without consulting your doctor as it may lead to unpleasant withdrawal symptoms, especially if you are taking higher dose of methylprednisolone.

Before taking PREDMET 4 TABLET inform your doctor if you any viral infections, or any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have hypertension, diabetes, thyroid deficiency, glaucoma, skin problem, gut inflammation, muscle problems, osteoporosis, any types of tumors or cancer in the body, depression or any other forms of mental illness.

It should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while taking PREDMET 4 TABLET as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of taking PREDMET 4 TABLET are high blood pressure, swelling of body parts, muscle cramps or weakness, skin thinning, feeling sad or depressed and slowed growth in children. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience severe depression with suicidal thoughts or severe stomach pain with blood-stained stools or vomit.

How PREDMET 4 TABLET Works

PREDMET 4 TABLET is a corticosteroid medicine with anti-inflammatory and immune suppressant properties. It boosts your body with sufficient corticosteroid levels (cortisol, aldosterone) during deficient conditions and helps your body to function properly.

It also reduces the release of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes inflammation. It manages graft rejection by suppressing the immune functions and protects your kidney from damage in patients with kidney problems.
