introduction:
Introduction About TRIROID 40MG INJECTION

TRIROID 40MG INJECTION contains Triamcinolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids. It is used to manage pain, swelling and stiffness in joints as seen in various disorders such as Rheumatoid Arthritis. It is also used to manage various allergic disorders such as asthma, hormonal problems, rheumatic fever and various disorders of the digestive system, skin, kidneys and lungs.

TRIROID 40MG INJECTION is not recommended if you are diagnosed with any condition affecting the kidney, liver and thyroid gland or any infection, hypertension and heart failure. Before taking TRIROID 40MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have/had infection recently such as Tuberculosis (TB), diabetes, bowel surgery, stomach ulcer and/or a bowel disorder, inflamed veins or infection in legs, mental health disorder, epilepsy, any form of cancer, osteoporosis (thick and brittle bones, myasthenia gravis, glaucoma, have visual disturbances, loss of vision, inflammation of the retina (viral retinitis) or of eyes (red, bloodshot eyes) etc.

TRIROID 40MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children below 6 years of age. Also, pregnant and nursing women are recommended to inform the doctor about their pregnancy and breastfeeding status, before receiving TRIROID 40MG INJECTION. The most common side effects of taking TRIROID 40MG INJECTION are increased risk of infection, reaction at the site reaction, headache and pain in joints. Consult your doctor if any of your symptoms get worse or persist.

mechanismOfAction:
How TRIROID 40MG INJECTION Works

TRIROID 40MG INJECTION is used to inhibit the synthesis of various chemicals that cause inflammation namely prostaglandins and leukotrienes. It works by decreasing the expression of cyclo-oxygenase, lipoxygenase enzymes, responsible for their production. It also decreases the activity of a certain nuclear factor called kappa-B which leads to decreased production of interleukin 6 and 8, which are pro-inflammatory substances.

introduction:
Introduction About ZEN MPS 4 TABLET

ZEN MPS 4 TABLET is used to manage various adrenal gland problems, including adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia, and nonsuppurative thyroiditis. It is also effective in managing autoimmune and inflammatory conditions affecting different parts of the body, such as rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, systemic lupus erythematosus, psoriasis, optic neuritis, uveitis, asthma, and certain blood disorders like leukemia. Additionally, it helps manage inflammatory bowel diseases like Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, as well as tuberculous meningitis in the brain.

This medication is also prescribed for managing severe allergic reactions, including drug-induced hypersensitivity, atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis, and allergic rhinitis. It can prevent graft rejection after organ transplantation and support kidney health by reducing protein loss in the urine or increasing urine output in conditions like nephrotic syndrome.

It contains a medicine called Methylprednisolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids.

Take ZEN MPS 4 TABLET as advised by your physician. Do not stop taking ZEN MPS 4 TABLET or reduce the dose of methylprednisolone without consulting your doctor as it may lead to unpleasant withdrawal symptoms, especially if you are taking higher dose of methylprednisolone.

Before taking ZEN MPS 4 TABLET inform your doctor if you any viral infections, or any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have hypertension, diabetes, thyroid deficiency, glaucoma, skin problem, gut inflammation, muscle problems, osteoporosis, any types of tumors or cancer in the body, depression or any other forms of mental illness.

It should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while taking ZEN MPS 4 TABLET as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of taking ZEN MPS 4 TABLET are high blood pressure, swelling of body parts, muscle cramps or weakness, skin thinning, feeling sad or depressed and slowed growth in children. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience severe depression with suicidal thoughts or severe stomach pain with blood-stained stools or vomit.

How ZEN MPS 4 TABLET Works

ZEN MPS 4 TABLET is a corticosteroid medicine with anti-inflammatory and immune suppressant properties. It boosts your body with sufficient corticosteroid levels (cortisol, aldosterone) during deficient conditions and helps your body to function properly.

It also reduces the release of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes inflammation. It manages graft rejection by suppressing the immune functions and protects your kidney from damage in patients with kidney problems.

introduction:
Introduction About DEPOTEX 4MG TABLET

DEPOTEX 4MG TABLET is used to manage various adrenal gland problems, including adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia, and nonsuppurative thyroiditis. It is also effective in managing autoimmune and inflammatory conditions affecting different parts of the body, such as rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, systemic lupus erythematosus, psoriasis, optic neuritis, uveitis, asthma, and certain blood disorders like leukemia. Additionally, it helps manage inflammatory bowel diseases like Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, as well as tuberculous meningitis in the brain.

This medication is also prescribed for managing severe allergic reactions, including drug-induced hypersensitivity, atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis, and allergic rhinitis. It can prevent graft rejection after organ transplantation and support kidney health by reducing protein loss in the urine or increasing urine output in conditions like nephrotic syndrome.

It contains a medicine called Methylprednisolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids.

Take DEPOTEX 4MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Do not stop taking DEPOTEX 4MG TABLET or reduce the dose of methylprednisolone without consulting your doctor as it may lead to unpleasant withdrawal symptoms, especially if you are taking higher dose of methylprednisolone.

Before taking DEPOTEX 4MG TABLET inform your doctor if you any viral infections, or any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have hypertension, diabetes, thyroid deficiency, glaucoma, skin problem, gut inflammation, muscle problems, osteoporosis, any types of tumors or cancer in the body, depression or any other forms of mental illness.

It should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while taking DEPOTEX 4MG TABLET as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of taking DEPOTEX 4MG TABLET are high blood pressure, swelling of body parts, muscle cramps or weakness, skin thinning, feeling sad or depressed and slowed growth in children. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience severe depression with suicidal thoughts or severe stomach pain with blood-stained stools or vomit.

mechanismOfAction:
How DEPOTEX 4MG TABLET Works

DEPOTEX 4MG TABLET is a corticosteroid medicine with anti-inflammatory and immune suppressant properties. It boosts your body with sufficient corticosteroid levels (cortisol, aldosterone) during deficient conditions and helps your body to function properly.

It also reduces the release of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes inflammation. It manages graft rejection by suppressing the immune functions and protects your kidney from damage in patients with kidney problems.

introduction:
Introduction About KENACORT 40MG INJECTION

KENACORT 40MG INJECTION contains Triamcinolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids. It is used to manage pain, swelling and stiffness in joints as seen in various disorders such as Rheumatoid Arthritis. It is also used to manage various allergic disorders such as asthma, hormonal problems, rheumatic fever and various disorders of the digestive system, skin, kidneys and lungs.

KENACORT 40MG INJECTION is not recommended if you are diagnosed with any condition affecting the kidney, liver and thyroid gland or any infection, hypertension and heart failure. Before taking KENACORT 40MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have/had infection recently such as Tuberculosis (TB), diabetes, bowel surgery, stomach ulcer and/or a bowel disorder, inflamed veins or infection in legs, mental health disorder, epilepsy, any form of cancer, osteoporosis (thick and brittle bones, myasthenia gravis, glaucoma, have visual disturbances, loss of vision, inflammation of the retina (viral retinitis) or of eyes (red, bloodshot eyes) etc.

KENACORT 40MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children below 6 years of age. Also, pregnant and nursing women are recommended to inform the doctor about their pregnancy and breastfeeding status, before receiving KENACORT 40MG INJECTION. The most common side effects of taking KENACORT 40MG INJECTION are increased risk of infection, reaction at the site reaction, headache and pain in joints. Consult your doctor if any of your symptoms get worse or persist.

mechanismOfAction:
How KENACORT 40MG INJECTION Works

KENACORT 40MG INJECTION is used to inhibit the synthesis of various chemicals that cause inflammation namely prostaglandins and leukotrienes. It works by decreasing the expression of cyclo-oxygenase, lipoxygenase enzymes, responsible for their production. It also decreases the activity of a certain nuclear factor called kappa-B which leads to decreased production of interleukin 6 and 8, which are pro-inflammatory substances.

KENACORT 40MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse in the muscles or joints. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About PREMAXO 80MG INJECTION

PREMAXO 80MG INJECTION is used to manage various adrenal gland problems, including adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia, and nonsuppurative thyroiditis. It is also effective in managing autoimmune and inflammatory conditions affecting different parts of the body, such as rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, systemic lupus erythematosus, psoriasis, optic neuritis, uveitis, asthma, and certain blood disorders like leukemia. Additionally, it helps manage inflammatory bowel diseases like Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, as well as tuberculous meningitis in the brain.

This medication is also prescribed for managing severe allergic reactions, including drug-induced hypersensitivity, atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis, and allergic rhinitis. It can prevent graft rejection after organ transplantation and support kidney health by reducing protein loss in the urine or increasing urine output in conditions like nephrotic syndrome.

It contains Methylprednisolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids.

Before receiving PREMAXO 80MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you any viral infections, or any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have hypertension, diabetes, thyroid deficiency, glaucoma, skin problem, gut inflammation, muscle problems, osteoporosis, any types of tumors or cancer in the body, depression or any other forms of mental illness.

PREMAXO 80MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe fungal infections, brain swelling due to malaria, or brain injury or stroke. It should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while receiving PREMAXO 80MG INJECTION as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of receiving PREMAXO 80MG INJECTION are high blood pressure, swelling of body parts, muscle cramps or weakness, skin thinning, feeling sad or depressed and slowed growth in children. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience severe depression with suicidal thoughts or severe stomach pain with blood-stained stools or vomit after receiving it.

mechanismOfAction:
How PREMAXO 80MG INJECTION Works

PREMAXO 80MG INJECTION is a corticosteroid medicine with anti-inflammatory and immune suppressant properties. It boosts your body with sufficient corticosteroid levels (cortisol, aldosterone) during deficient conditions and helps your body to function properly.

It also reduces the release of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes pain, swelling and inflammation. It manages graft rejection by suppressing the immune functions and protects your kidney from damage in patients with kidney problems.

introduction:
Introduction About PREDZEN 16MG TABLET

PREDZEN 16MG TABLET is used to manage various adrenal gland problems, including adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia, and nonsuppurative thyroiditis. It is also effective in managing autoimmune and inflammatory conditions affecting different parts of the body, such as rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, systemic lupus erythematosus, psoriasis, optic neuritis, uveitis, asthma, and certain blood disorders like leukemia. Additionally, it helps manage inflammatory bowel diseases like Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, as well as tuberculous meningitis in the brain.

This medication is also prescribed for managing severe allergic reactions, including drug-induced hypersensitivity, atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis, and allergic rhinitis. It can prevent graft rejection after organ transplantation and support kidney health by reducing protein loss in the urine or increasing urine output in conditions like nephrotic syndrome.

It contains a medicine called Methylprednisolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids.

Take PREDZEN 16MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Do not stop taking PREDZEN 16MG TABLET or reduce the dose of methylprednisolone without consulting your doctor as it may lead to unpleasant withdrawal symptoms, especially if you are taking higher dose of methylprednisolone.

Before taking PREDZEN 16MG TABLET inform your doctor if you any viral infections, or any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have hypertension, diabetes, thyroid deficiency, glaucoma, skin problem, gut inflammation, muscle problems, osteoporosis, any types of tumors or cancer in the body, depression or any other forms of mental illness.

It should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while taking PREDZEN 16MG TABLET as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of taking PREDZEN 16MG TABLET are high blood pressure, swelling of body parts, muscle cramps or weakness, skin thinning, feeling sad or depressed and slowed growth in children. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience severe depression with suicidal thoughts or severe stomach pain with blood-stained stools or vomit.

mechanismOfAction:
How PREDZEN 16MG TABLET Works

PREDZEN 16MG TABLET is a corticosteroid medicine with anti-inflammatory and immune suppressant properties. It boosts your body with sufficient corticosteroid levels (cortisol, aldosterone) during deficient conditions and helps your body to function properly.

It also reduces the release of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes inflammation. It manages graft rejection by suppressing the immune functions and protects your kidney from damage in patients with kidney problems.

introduction:
Introduction About ZEN MPS 8MG TABLET

ZEN MPS 8MG TABLET is used to manage various adrenal gland problems, including adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia, and nonsuppurative thyroiditis. It is also effective in managing autoimmune and inflammatory conditions affecting different parts of the body, such as rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, systemic lupus erythematosus, psoriasis, optic neuritis, uveitis, asthma, and certain blood disorders like leukemia. Additionally, it helps manage inflammatory bowel diseases like Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, as well as tuberculous meningitis in the brain.

This medication is also prescribed for managing severe allergic reactions, including drug-induced hypersensitivity, atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis, and allergic rhinitis. It can prevent graft rejection after organ transplantation and support kidney health by reducing protein loss in the urine or increasing urine output in conditions like nephrotic syndrome.

It contains a medicine called Methylprednisolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids.

Take ZEN MPS 8MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Do not stop taking ZEN MPS 8MG TABLET or reduce the dose of methylprednisolone without consulting your doctor as it may lead to unpleasant withdrawal symptoms, especially if you are taking higher dose of methylprednisolone.

Before taking ZEN MPS 8MG TABLET inform your doctor if you any viral infections, or any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have hypertension, diabetes, thyroid deficiency, glaucoma, skin problem, gut inflammation, muscle problems, osteoporosis, any types of tumors or cancer in the body, depression or any other forms of mental illness.

It should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while taking ZEN MPS 8MG TABLET as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of taking ZEN MPS 8MG TABLET are high blood pressure, swelling of body parts, muscle cramps or weakness, skin thinning, feeling sad or depressed and slowed growth in children. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

Interactions

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before taking ZEN MPS 8MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines such as:

Acetazolamide (a medicine used to manage glaucoma or edema)
Aminoglutethimide or cyclophosphamide (used for managing cancer)
Anticoagulants (used for blood thinning) such as acenocoumarol, phenindione and warfarin
Anti-cholinergic medicines used to manage myasthenia gravis (such as distigmine and neostigmine)
Antibacterials (Ex. isoniazid, erythromycin, clarithromycin and troleandomycin)
Anti diabetics (Ex. metformin, glipizide)
Aprepitant or fosaprepitant (antiemitics)
Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory medicines (used for fever and pain relief) such as aspirin, ibuprofen
Antiepileptics (such as carbamazepine, phenytoin and primidone)
Carbenoxolone and cimetidine (antiulcer agents)
Ciclosporin, tacrolimus (immunosuppressants)
Cardiovascular agents (such as digoxin, diltiazem or mibefradil)
Oral contraceptives (birth control pills) Ex. ethinylestridiol and norethisterone
Medicines used to manage HIV infection (such as ritonavir, indinavir, cobicistat)
Antifungals (such as ketoconazole, amphotericin B, itraconazole)
Muscle relaxants (Ex. pancuronium or vecuronium)
Diuretics (used to manage edema and hypertension) Ex. furosemide, chlorothiazide, hydrochlorothiazide
Medicines used to manage asthma (such as aminophylline, salmeterol, formoterol)
Rifampicin and rifabutin (Antituberculosis)
Live vaccines

Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while taking ZEN MPS 8MG TABLET as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

If you or anyone else accidentally took more ZEN MPS 8MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital straight away.

introduction:
Introduction About PREDACE 8MG TABLET

PREDACE 8MG TABLET is used to manage various adrenal gland problems, including adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia, and nonsuppurative thyroiditis. It is also effective in managing autoimmune and inflammatory conditions affecting different parts of the body, such as rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, systemic lupus erythematosus, psoriasis, optic neuritis, uveitis, asthma, and certain blood disorders like leukemia. Additionally, it helps manage inflammatory bowel diseases like Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, as well as tuberculous meningitis in the brain.

This medication is also prescribed for managing severe allergic reactions, including drug-induced hypersensitivity, atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis, and allergic rhinitis. It can prevent graft rejection after organ transplantation and support kidney health by reducing protein loss in the urine or increasing urine output in conditions like nephrotic syndrome.

It contains a medicine called Methylprednisolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids.

Take PREDACE 8MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Do not stop taking PREDACE 8MG TABLET or reduce the dose of methylprednisolone without consulting your doctor as it may lead to unpleasant withdrawal symptoms, especially if you are taking higher dose of methylprednisolone.

Before taking PREDACE 8MG TABLET inform your doctor if you any viral infections, or any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have hypertension, diabetes, thyroid deficiency, glaucoma, skin problem, gut inflammation, muscle problems, osteoporosis, any types of tumors or cancer in the body, depression or any other forms of mental illness.

It should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while taking PREDACE 8MG TABLET as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of taking PREDACE 8MG TABLET are high blood pressure, swelling of body parts, muscle cramps or weakness, skin thinning, feeling sad or depressed and slowed growth in children. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience severe depression with suicidal thoughts or severe stomach pain with blood-stained stools or vomit.

mechanismOfAction:
How PREDACE 8MG TABLET Works

PREDACE 8MG TABLET is a corticosteroid medicine with anti-inflammatory and immune suppressant properties. It boosts your body with sufficient corticosteroid levels (cortisol, aldosterone) during deficient conditions and helps your body to function properly.

It also reduces the release of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes inflammation. It manages graft rejection by suppressing the immune functions and protects your kidney from damage in patients with kidney problems.

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before taking MEPRESSO T 8MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines such as:

Acetazolamide (a medicine used to manage glaucoma or edema)
Aminoglutethimide or cyclophosphamide (used for managing cancer)
Anticoagulants (used for blood thinning) such as acenocoumarol, phenindione and warfarin
Anti-cholinergic medicines used to manage myasthenia gravis (such as distigmine and neostigmine)
Antibacterials (Ex. isoniazid, erythromycin, clarithromycin and troleandomycin)
Anti diabetics (Ex. metformin, glipizide)
Aprepitant or fosaprepitant (antiemitics)

Ciclosporin, tacrolimus (immunosuppressants)
Cardiovascular agents (such as digoxin, diltiazem or mibefradil)
Oral contraceptives (birth control pills) Ex. ethinylestridiol and norethisterone
Medicines used to manage HIV infection (such as ritonavir, indinavir, cobicistat)

Live vaccines

introduction:
Introduction About DEPOTEX 16MG TABLET

DEPOTEX 16MG TABLET is used to manage various adrenal gland problems, including adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia, and nonsuppurative thyroiditis. It is also effective in managing autoimmune and inflammatory conditions affecting different parts of the body, such as rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, systemic lupus erythematosus, psoriasis, optic neuritis, uveitis, asthma, and certain blood disorders like leukemia. Additionally, it helps manage inflammatory bowel diseases like Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, as well as tuberculous meningitis in the brain.

This medication is also prescribed for managing severe allergic reactions, including drug-induced hypersensitivity, atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis, and allergic rhinitis. It can prevent graft rejection after organ transplantation and support kidney health by reducing protein loss in the urine or increasing urine output in conditions like nephrotic syndrome.

It contains a medicine called Methylprednisolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids.

Take DEPOTEX 16MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Do not stop taking DEPOTEX 16MG TABLET or reduce the dose of methylprednisolone without consulting your doctor as it may lead to unpleasant withdrawal symptoms, especially if you are taking higher dose of methylprednisolone.

Before taking DEPOTEX 16MG TABLET inform your doctor if you any viral infections, or any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have hypertension, diabetes, thyroid deficiency, glaucoma, skin problem, gut inflammation, muscle problems, osteoporosis, any types of tumors or cancer in the body, depression or any other forms of mental illness.

It should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while taking DEPOTEX 16MG TABLET as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of taking DEPOTEX 16MG TABLET are high blood pressure, swelling of body parts, muscle cramps or weakness, skin thinning, feeling sad or depressed and slowed growth in children. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience severe depression with suicidal thoughts or severe stomach pain with blood-stained stools or vomit.

mechanismOfAction:
How DEPOTEX 16MG TABLET Works

DEPOTEX 16MG TABLET is a corticosteroid medicine with anti-inflammatory and immune suppressant properties. It boosts your body with sufficient corticosteroid levels (cortisol, aldosterone) during deficient conditions and helps your body to function properly.

It also reduces the release of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes inflammation. It manages graft rejection by suppressing the immune functions and protects your kidney from damage in patients with kidney problems.

introduction:
Introduction About PREDZEN 4MG TABLET

PREDZEN 4MG TABLET is used to manage various adrenal gland problems, including adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia, and nonsuppurative thyroiditis. It is also effective in managing autoimmune and inflammatory conditions affecting different parts of the body, such as rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, systemic lupus erythematosus, psoriasis, optic neuritis, uveitis, asthma, and certain blood disorders like leukemia. Additionally, it helps manage inflammatory bowel diseases like Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, as well as tuberculous meningitis in the brain.

This medication is also prescribed for managing severe allergic reactions, including drug-induced hypersensitivity, atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis, and allergic rhinitis. It can prevent graft rejection after organ transplantation and support kidney health by reducing protein loss in the urine or increasing urine output in conditions like nephrotic syndrome.

It contains a medicine called Methylprednisolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids.

Take PREDZEN 4MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Do not stop taking PREDZEN 4MG TABLET or reduce the dose of methylprednisolone without consulting your doctor as it may lead to unpleasant withdrawal symptoms, especially if you are taking higher dose of methylprednisolone.

Before taking PREDZEN 4MG TABLET inform your doctor if you any viral infections, or any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have hypertension, diabetes, thyroid deficiency, glaucoma, skin problem, gut inflammation, muscle problems, osteoporosis, any types of tumors or cancer in the body, depression or any other forms of mental illness.

It should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while taking PREDZEN 4MG TABLET as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of taking PREDZEN 4MG TABLET are high blood pressure, swelling of body parts, muscle cramps or weakness, skin thinning, feeling sad or depressed and slowed growth in children. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience severe depression with suicidal thoughts or severe stomach pain with blood-stained stools or vomit.

PREDZEN 4MG TABLET is a corticosteroid medicine with anti-inflammatory and immune suppressant properties. It boosts your body with sufficient corticosteroid levels (cortisol, aldosterone) during deficient conditions and helps your body to function properly.

Interactions

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before taking PREDZEN 4MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines such as:

Acetazolamide (a medicine used to manage glaucoma or edema)
Aminoglutethimide or cyclophosphamide (used for managing cancer)
Anticoagulants (used for blood thinning) such as acenocoumarol, phenindione and warfarin
Anti-cholinergic medicines used to manage myasthenia gravis (such as distigmine and neostigmine)
Antibacterials (Ex. isoniazid, erythromycin, clarithromycin and troleandomycin)
Anti diabetics (Ex. metformin, glipizide)
Aprepitant or fosaprepitant (antiemitics)
Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory medicines (used for fever and pain relief) such as aspirin, ibuprofen
Antiepileptics (such as carbamazepine, phenytoin and primidone)
Carbenoxolone and cimetidine (antiulcer agents)
Ciclosporin, tacrolimus (immunosuppressants)
Cardiovascular agents (such as digoxin, diltiazem or mibefradil)
Oral contraceptives (birth control pills) Ex. ethinylestridiol and norethisterone
Medicines used to manage HIV infection (such as ritonavir, indinavir, cobicistat)
Antifungals (such as ketoconazole, amphotericin B, itraconazole)
Muscle relaxants (Ex. pancuronium or vecuronium)
Diuretics (used to manage edema and hypertension) Ex. furosemide, chlorothiazide, hydrochlorothiazide
Medicines used to manage asthma (such as aminophylline, salmeterol, formoterol)
Rifampicin and rifabutin (Antituberculosis)
Live vaccines

B. Drug - Food interaction:

Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while taking PREDZEN 4MG TABLET as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took more PREDZEN 4MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital straight away.

introduction:
Introduction About PREDACE

PREDACE is used to manage various adrenal gland problems, including adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia, and nonsuppurative thyroiditis. It is also effective in managing autoimmune and inflammatory conditions affecting different parts of the body, such as rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, systemic lupus erythematosus, psoriasis, optic neuritis, uveitis, asthma, and certain blood disorders like leukemia. Additionally, it helps manage inflammatory bowel diseases like Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, as well as tuberculous meningitis in the brain.

This medication is also prescribed for managing severe allergic reactions, including drug-induced hypersensitivity, atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis, and allergic rhinitis. It can prevent graft rejection after organ transplantation and support kidney health by reducing protein loss in the urine or increasing urine output in conditions like nephrotic syndrome.

It contains a medicine called Methylprednisolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids.

Take PREDACE as advised by your physician. Do not stop taking PREDACE or reduce the dose of methylprednisolone without consulting your doctor as it may lead to unpleasant withdrawal symptoms, especially if you are taking higher dose of methylprednisolone.

Before taking PREDACE inform your doctor if you any viral infections, or any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have hypertension, diabetes, thyroid deficiency, glaucoma, skin problem, gut inflammation, muscle problems, osteoporosis, any types of tumors or cancer in the body, depression or any other forms of mental illness.

It should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while taking PREDACE as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of taking PREDACE are high blood pressure, swelling of body parts, muscle cramps or weakness, skin thinning, feeling sad or depressed and slowed growth in children. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience severe depression with suicidal thoughts or severe stomach pain with blood-stained stools or vomit.

mechanismOfAction:
How PREDACE Works

PREDACE is a corticosteroid medicine with anti-inflammatory and immune suppressant properties. It boosts your body with sufficient corticosteroid levels (cortisol, aldosterone) during deficient conditions and helps your body to function properly.

It also reduces the release of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes inflammation. It manages graft rejection by suppressing the immune functions and protects your kidney from damage in patients with kidney problems.

introduction:
Introduction About MACPRED 40MG INJECTION

MACPRED 40MG INJECTION is used to manage various adrenal gland problems, including adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia, and nonsuppurative thyroiditis. It is also effective in managing autoimmune and inflammatory conditions affecting different parts of the body, such as rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, systemic lupus erythematosus, psoriasis, optic neuritis, uveitis, asthma, and certain blood disorders like leukemia. Additionally, it helps manage inflammatory bowel diseases like Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, as well as tuberculous meningitis in the brain.

This medication is also prescribed for managing severe allergic reactions, including drug-induced hypersensitivity, atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis, and allergic rhinitis. It can prevent graft rejection after organ transplantation and support kidney health by reducing protein loss in the urine or increasing urine output in conditions like nephrotic syndrome.

It contains Methylprednisolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids.

Before receiving MACPRED 40MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you any viral infections, or any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have hypertension, diabetes, thyroid deficiency, glaucoma, skin problem, gut inflammation, muscle problems, osteoporosis, any types of tumors or cancer in the body, depression or any other forms of mental illness.

MACPRED 40MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe fungal infections, brain swelling due to malaria, or brain injury or stroke. It should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while receiving MACPRED 40MG INJECTION as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of receiving MACPRED 40MG INJECTION are high blood pressure, swelling of body parts, muscle cramps or weakness, skin thinning, feeling sad or depressed and slowed growth in children. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience severe depression with suicidal thoughts or severe stomach pain with blood-stained stools or vomit after receiving it.

mechanismOfAction:
How MACPRED 40MG INJECTION Works

MACPRED 40MG INJECTION is a corticosteroid medicine with anti-inflammatory and immune suppressant properties. It boosts your body with sufficient corticosteroid levels (cortisol, aldosterone) during deficient conditions and helps your body to function properly.

It also reduces the release of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes pain, swelling and inflammation. It manages graft rejection by suppressing the immune functions and protects your kidney from damage in patients with kidney problems.

MACPRED 40MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the muscle (intramuscularly) or into the vein (intravenously). Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About DEXAMETHASONE (TORQUE) INJECTION

DEXAMETHASONE (TORQUE) INJECTION contains Dexamethasone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids. It is used to manage problematic conditions of the adrenal glands (such as adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia and nonsuppurative thyroiditis).

It can also be used to manage various inflammatory auto-immune disease conditions affecting the bones and joints (Ex. rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis), skin and collagen (Ex. Stevens-Johnson syndrome, psoriasis), eyes (Ex. optic neuritis, uveitis or iritis), respiratory tract (Ex. asthma, pneumonitis, tuberculosis), blood and lymph (Ex. leukaemia, anemia, thrombocytopenia, blood cancer, lymph cancer, sarcoidosis), bowel and gut (Ex. Crohn’s disease and ulcerative colitis), brain (Ex. tuberculous meningitis, cerebral edema associated with brain tumor, increased pressure within the skull) and heart (inflammation of heart membranes).

It is also indicated in the management of drug induced hypersensitivity reactions and in other allergic reactions (such as atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis and allergic rhinitis). It also corrects calcium levels among cancer patients and increases urine output or reduces protein loss via urine among patients having kidney problems (such as nephrotic syndrome).

Before receiving DEXAMETHASONE (TORQUE) INJECTION inform your doctor if you any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension, glaucoma, epilepsy, underactive thyroid, muscle problems, osteoporosis, stomach problems, tuberculosis, depression, mania or any other mental problems as a precaution.

DEXAMETHASONE (TORQUE) INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with serious unmanageed infections in the body or bone problems. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women.

The most common side effects of receiving DEXAMETHASONE (TORQUE) INJECTION are headache, dizziness, acne, stomach discomfort, slow wound healing, skin thinning, high blood pressure, fluid retention, swelling and weight gain of the body and face, high blood sugar levels, muscle weakness, bone thinning and irregular menstrual periods. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How DEXAMETHASONE (TORQUE) INJECTION Works

DEXAMETHASONE (TORQUE) INJECTION is a steroid medicine with anti-inflammatory and immune suppressant properties. It boosts your body with sufficient corticosteroid levels (cortisol, aldosterone) during deficient conditions and helps your body to function properly.

It also reduces the release of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes inflammation, pain, irritation and swelling. As a result, it reduces allergic and inflammatory conditions in the body.
usageDetails:
How to use DEXAMETHASONE (TORQUE) INJECTION

DEXAMETHASONE (TORQUE) INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein, muscle, joints or tendons depending upon the site of inflammation.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: DEXAMETHASONE (TORQUE) INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.

DEXAMETHASONE (TORQUE) INJECTION is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk and affect the nursing infant. Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.
DEXAMETHASONE (TORQUE) INJECTION is unlikely to affect your ability to drive or handle any heavy tools or machines.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while receiving DEXAMETHASONE (TORQUE) INJECTION as it may make you feel drowsier.
DEXAMETHASONE (TORQUE) INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with kidney diseases. Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.
DEXAMETHASONE (TORQUE) INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases. Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.
Talk to your doctor before receiving DEXAMETHASONE (TORQUE) INJECTION if you are allergic to Dexamethasone.
DEXAMETHASONE (TORQUE) INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with heart problems (such as recent heart attack or heart failure). Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.
DEXAMETHASONE (TORQUE) INJECTION should be used in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) only if prescribed by the physician. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before receiving it.
DEXAMETHASONE (TORQUE) INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.

Others

DEXAMETHASONE (TORQUE) INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have any serious infection that affects the whole body
Have any bone or joint problems
Have infections in the joints
Are about to get vaccinated (live-virus vaccine)

Before receiving DEXAMETHASONE (TORQUE) INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Currently have or previously had depression, bipolar disorder or any other mental illnesses
Have a family history of mental problems
Have diabetes or a family history of diabetes
Have fits
Have or have a family history of glaucoma
Have viral or fungal infections of the eyes
Have hypertension (high blood pressure)
Have underactive thyroid gland (hypothyroidism)
Have malaria affecting the brain
Have or had been in contact with someone who has chickenpox, measles or shingles
Have any muscle problems (Ex. myasthenia gravis)
Have osteoporosis (brittle bones)
Have pheochromocytoma (a rare tumor of the adrenal glands)
Have stomach ulcer or other serious stomach or intestinal problems
Have or had tuberculosis
Have symptoms of tumour lysis syndrome (such as muscle cramping, muscle weakness, confusion, visual loss or disturbances and shortness of breath)
Are scheduled for any upcoming surgery (including dental surgery)
Have any parasitic infection
Have Cushing’s disease
Have brain injury due to trauma
Have had stroke or any unusual stress

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before receiving DEXAMETHASONE (TORQUE) INJECTION, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines such as:

Aminoglutethimide or cyclophosphamide (used for managing cancer)
Anticoagulants (used for blood thinning) such as acenocoumarol, phenindione and warfarin
Medicines used to manage bacterial infections (Ex. isoniazid, erythromycin, clarithromycin and troleandomycin)
Medicines used to manage diabetes (Ex. metformin, glipizide)
Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory medicines (used for fever and pain relief) such as aspirin, ibuprofen
Medicines used to manage epilepsy (such as carbamazepine, phenytoin and primidone)
Ephedrine (used for cough)
Medicines used to manage HIV infections such as ritonavir, cobicistat
Medicines used to manage fungal infection (such as ketoconazole, amphotericin B, itraconazole)
Diuretics (used to manage edema and hypertension) Ex. furosemide, chlorothiazide, hydrochlorothiazide
Rifampicin and rifabutin (used to manage tuberculosis)
Carbenoxolone (used to manage mouth ulcer)
Anti-cholinergic medicines used to manage myasthenia gravis (such as distigmine and neostigmine)
Acetazolamide (a medicine used to manage glaucoma or edema)

Overdosage:

DEXAMETHASONE (TORQUE) INJECTION will be administered to you only by a doctor or a nurse in a hospital and so it is unlikely to receive an overdose. However, consult your doctor or nurse if you experience any unusual symptoms.

introduction:
Introduction About NUCORT M 4MG TABLET

NUCORT M 4MG TABLET is used to manage various adrenal gland problems, including adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia, and nonsuppurative thyroiditis. It is also effective in managing autoimmune and inflammatory conditions affecting different parts of the body, such as rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, systemic lupus erythematosus, psoriasis, optic neuritis, uveitis, asthma, and certain blood disorders like leukemia. Additionally, it helps manage inflammatory bowel diseases like Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, as well as tuberculous meningitis in the brain.

This medication is also prescribed for managing severe allergic reactions, including drug-induced hypersensitivity, atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis, and allergic rhinitis. It can prevent graft rejection after organ transplantation and support kidney health by reducing protein loss in the urine or increasing urine output in conditions like nephrotic syndrome.

It contains a medicine called Methylprednisolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids.

Take NUCORT M 4MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Do not stop taking NUCORT M 4MG TABLET or reduce the dose of methylprednisolone without consulting your doctor as it may lead to unpleasant withdrawal symptoms, especially if you are taking higher dose of methylprednisolone.

Before taking NUCORT M 4MG TABLET inform your doctor if you any viral infections, or any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have hypertension, diabetes, thyroid deficiency, glaucoma, skin problem, gut inflammation, muscle problems, osteoporosis, any types of tumors or cancer in the body, depression or any other forms of mental illness.

It should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while taking NUCORT M 4MG TABLET as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of taking NUCORT M 4MG TABLET are high blood pressure, swelling of body parts, muscle cramps or weakness, skin thinning, feeling sad or depressed and slowed growth in children. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience severe depression with suicidal thoughts or severe stomach pain with blood-stained stools or vomit.

introduction:
Introduction About PREDZEN 8MG TABLET

PREDZEN 8MG TABLET is used to manage various adrenal gland problems, including adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia, and nonsuppurative thyroiditis. It is also effective in managing autoimmune and inflammatory conditions affecting different parts of the body, such as rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, systemic lupus erythematosus, psoriasis, optic neuritis, uveitis, asthma, and certain blood disorders like leukemia. Additionally, it helps manage inflammatory bowel diseases like Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, as well as tuberculous meningitis in the brain.

This medication is also prescribed for managing severe allergic reactions, including drug-induced hypersensitivity, atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis, and allergic rhinitis. It can prevent graft rejection after organ transplantation and support kidney health by reducing protein loss in the urine or increasing urine output in conditions like nephrotic syndrome.

It contains a medicine called Methylprednisolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids.

Take PREDZEN 8MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Do not stop taking PREDZEN 8MG TABLET or reduce the dose of methylprednisolone without consulting your doctor as it may lead to unpleasant withdrawal symptoms, especially if you are taking higher dose of methylprednisolone.

Before taking PREDZEN 8MG TABLET inform your doctor if you any viral infections, or any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have hypertension, diabetes, thyroid deficiency, glaucoma, skin problem, gut inflammation, muscle problems, osteoporosis, any types of tumors or cancer in the body, depression or any other forms of mental illness.

It should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while taking PREDZEN 8MG TABLET as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of taking PREDZEN 8MG TABLET are high blood pressure, swelling of body parts, muscle cramps or weakness, skin thinning, feeling sad or depressed and slowed growth in children. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience severe depression with suicidal thoughts or severe stomach pain with blood-stained stools or vomit.

mechanismOfAction:
How PREDZEN 8MG TABLET Works

PREDZEN 8MG TABLET is a corticosteroid medicine with anti-inflammatory and immune suppressant properties. It boosts your body with sufficient corticosteroid levels (cortisol, aldosterone) during deficient conditions and helps your body to function properly.

It also reduces the release of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes inflammation. It manages graft rejection by suppressing the immune functions and protects your kidney from damage in patients with kidney problems.

introduction:
Introduction About PREDZEST 16MG TABLET

PREDZEST 16MG TABLET is used to manage various adrenal gland problems, including adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia, and nonsuppurative thyroiditis. It is also effective in managing autoimmune and inflammatory conditions affecting different parts of the body, such as rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, systemic lupus erythematosus, psoriasis, optic neuritis, uveitis, asthma, and certain blood disorders like leukemia. Additionally, it helps manage inflammatory bowel diseases like Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, as well as tuberculous meningitis in the brain.

This medication is also prescribed for managing severe allergic reactions, including drug-induced hypersensitivity, atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis, and allergic rhinitis. It can prevent graft rejection after organ transplantation and support kidney health by reducing protein loss in the urine or increasing urine output in conditions like nephrotic syndrome.

It contains a medicine called Methylprednisolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids.

Take PREDZEST 16MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Do not stop taking PREDZEST 16MG TABLET or reduce the dose of methylprednisolone without consulting your doctor as it may lead to unpleasant withdrawal symptoms, especially if you are taking higher dose of methylprednisolone.

Before taking PREDZEST 16MG TABLET inform your doctor if you any viral infections, or any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have hypertension, diabetes, thyroid deficiency, glaucoma, skin problem, gut inflammation, muscle problems, osteoporosis, any types of tumors or cancer in the body, depression or any other forms of mental illness.

It should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while taking PREDZEST 16MG TABLET as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of taking PREDZEST 16MG TABLET are high blood pressure, swelling of body parts, muscle cramps or weakness, skin thinning, feeling sad or depressed and slowed growth in children. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience severe depression with suicidal thoughts or severe stomach pain with blood-stained stools or vomit.

mechanismOfAction:
How PREDZEST 16MG TABLET Works

PREDZEST 16MG TABLET is a corticosteroid medicine with anti-inflammatory and immune suppressant properties. It boosts your body with sufficient corticosteroid levels (cortisol, aldosterone) during deficient conditions and helps your body to function properly.

It also reduces the release of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes inflammation. It manages graft rejection by suppressing the immune functions and protects your kidney from damage in patients with kidney problems.

Introduction About SOLU MEDROL 500MG INJECTION

SOLU MEDROL 500MG INJECTION is used to manage various adrenal gland problems, including adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia, and nonsuppurative thyroiditis. It is also effective in managing autoimmune and inflammatory conditions affecting different parts of the body, such as rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, systemic lupus erythematosus, psoriasis, optic neuritis, uveitis, asthma, and certain blood disorders like leukemia. Additionally, it helps manage inflammatory bowel diseases like Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, as well as tuberculous meningitis in the brain.

This medication is also prescribed for managing severe allergic reactions, including drug-induced hypersensitivity, atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis, and allergic rhinitis. It can prevent graft rejection after organ transplantation and support kidney health by reducing protein loss in the urine or increasing urine output in conditions like nephrotic syndrome.

It contains Methylprednisolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids.

Before receiving SOLU MEDROL 500MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you any viral infections, or any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have hypertension, diabetes, thyroid deficiency, glaucoma, skin problem, gut inflammation, muscle problems, osteoporosis, any types of tumors or cancer in the body, depression or any other forms of mental illness.

SOLU MEDROL 500MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe fungal infections, brain swelling due to malaria, or brain injury or stroke. It should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while receiving SOLU MEDROL 500MG INJECTION as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of receiving SOLU MEDROL 500MG INJECTION are high blood pressure, swelling of body parts, muscle cramps or weakness, skin thinning, feeling sad or depressed and slowed growth in children. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience severe depression with suicidal thoughts or severe stomach pain with blood-stained stools or vomit after receiving it.

mechanismOfAction:
How SOLU MEDROL 500MG INJECTION Works

SOLU MEDROL 500MG INJECTION is a corticosteroid medicine with anti-inflammatory and immune suppressant properties. It boosts your body with sufficient corticosteroid levels (cortisol, aldosterone) during deficient conditions and helps your body to function properly.

It also reduces the release of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes pain, swelling and inflammation. It manages graft rejection by suppressing the immune functions and protects your kidney from damage in patients with kidney problems.

How to use SOLU MEDROL 500MG INJECTION

SOLU MEDROL 500MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the muscle (intramuscularly) or into the vein (intravenously). Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Got vaccinated recently or scheduled for any upcoming vaccinations

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before receiving SOLU MEDROL 500MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines such as:

Acetazolamide (a medicine used to manage glaucoma or edema)
Aminoglutethimide or cyclophosphamide (used for managing cancer)
Anticoagulants (used for blood thinning) such as acenocoumarol, phenindione and warfarin
Anti-cholinergic medicines used to manage myasthenia gravis (such as distigmine and neostigmine)
Antibacterials (Ex. isoniazid, erythromycin, clarithromycin and troleandomycin)
Anti diabetics (Ex. metformin, glipizide)
Aprepitant or fosaprepitant (antiemitics)
Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory medicines (used for fever and pain relief) such as aspirin, ibuprofen
Antiepileptics (such as carbamazepine, phenytoin and primidone)
Carbenoxolone and cimetidine (antiulcer agents)
Ciclosporin, tacrolimus (immunosuppressants)
Cardiovascular agents (such as digoxin, diltiazem or mibefradil)
Oral contraceptives (birth control pills) Ex. ethinylestridiol and norethisterone
Medicines used to manage HIV infection (such as ritonavir, indinavir, cobicistat)
Antifungals (such as ketoconazole, amphotericin B, itraconazole)
Muscle relaxants (Ex. pancuronium or vecuronium)
Diuretics (used to manage edema and hypertension) Ex. furosemide, chlorothiazide, hydrochlorothiazide
Medicines used to manage asthma (such as aminophylline, salmeterol, formoterol)
Rifampicin and rifabutin (Antituberculosis)
Live vaccines

B. Drug - Food interaction:

Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while undergoing therapy with SOLU MEDROL 500MG INJECTION as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

Overdosage:

SOLU MEDROL 500MG INJECTION will be administered to you only by a doctor or a nurse in a hospital, and so it is unlikely to receive an overdose. However, consult your doctor or nurse if you experience any unusual symptoms.

introduction:
Introduction About IVEPRED 4MG TABLET

IVEPRED 4MG TABLET is used to manage various adrenal gland problems, including adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia, and nonsuppurative thyroiditis. It is also effective in managing autoimmune and inflammatory conditions affecting different parts of the body, such as rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, systemic lupus erythematosus, psoriasis, optic neuritis, uveitis, asthma, and certain blood disorders like leukemia. Additionally, it helps manage inflammatory bowel diseases like Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, as well as tuberculous meningitis in the brain.

This medication is also prescribed for managing severe allergic reactions, including drug-induced hypersensitivity, atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis, and allergic rhinitis. It can prevent graft rejection after organ transplantation and support kidney health by reducing protein loss in the urine or increasing urine output in conditions like nephrotic syndrome.

It contains a medicine called Methylprednisolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids.

Take IVEPRED 4MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Do not stop taking IVEPRED 4MG TABLET or reduce the dose of methylprednisolone without consulting your doctor as it may lead to unpleasant withdrawal symptoms, especially if you are taking higher dose of methylprednisolone.

Before taking IVEPRED 4MG TABLET inform your doctor if you any viral infections, or any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have hypertension, diabetes, thyroid deficiency, glaucoma, skin problem, gut inflammation, muscle problems, osteoporosis, any types of tumors or cancer in the body, depression or any other forms of mental illness.

It should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while taking IVEPRED 4MG TABLET as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of taking IVEPRED 4MG TABLET are high blood pressure, swelling of body parts, muscle cramps or weakness, skin thinning, feeling sad or depressed and slowed growth in children. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience severe depression with suicidal thoughts or severe stomach pain with blood-stained stools or vomit.

mechanismOfAction:
How IVEPRED 4MG TABLET Works

IVEPRED 4MG TABLET is a corticosteroid medicine with anti-inflammatory and immune suppressant properties. It boosts your body with sufficient corticosteroid levels (cortisol, aldosterone) during deficient conditions and helps your body to function properly.

It also reduces the release of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes inflammation. It manages graft rejection by suppressing the immune functions and protects your kidney from damage in patients with kidney problems.

High blood pressure (causing headache, or a general feeling of being unwell)
Swelling of body parts
Muscle cramps, weakness or wasting
Cataract, blurred vision
Slowed growth in children
Moon shaped face (Cushingoid facies)
Feeling sad, mood changes, mania, anxiety
Problems in sleeping
Difficulty in thinking, confusion, loss of memory, hallucinations
Fear or frightening thoughts
Acne, poor wound healing
Skin thinning

Contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects while undergoing therapy with PRED M 8 TABLET:

Signs of allergic reaction (such as skin rash, itching, blistering and peeling of the skin, swelling of the face, lips, mouth, throat which may lead to breathing difficulties)
Signs of bleeding in the gut (such as stomach pain which radiates until your back, bleeding from the anus, black or blood-stained stools, blood in vomit)
Increased infections causing fever or a general feeling of being unwell
Signs of flare up of a previous tuberculosis infection (such as coughing blood or pain in the chest)
Signs of pancreatitis (inflammation of pancreas causing severe stomach pain and vomiting)
Signs of blood clot in lungs (such as sharp chest pain, shortness of breath, coughing up blood)
Signs of increased pressure within the skull (such as severe headaches with vomiting, lack of energy and drowsiness) usually occurs once therapy is stopped
Thrombophlebitis (blood clots in vein supplying the legs causing leg pain, swelling, redness and tenderness)
Feeling depressed, suicidal thoughts
Blurred vision or other visual disturbances

Introduction About DYDROPREG SR 20 TABLET
What is DYDROPREG SR 20 TABLET?

DYDROPREG SR 20 TABLET contains Dydrogesterone, a well-studied synthetic progesterone. It is often prescribed as part of a hormone support plan for individuals managing menstrual cycle irregularities or undergoing reproductive care. This tablet mimics the action of natural progesterone, contributing to a more stable hormonal profile.

Use DYDROPREG SR 20 TABLET exactly as directed by your healthcare provider. It is usually taken orally with or without food. Dosage and duration depend on your specific health goals and medical history.

During management with DYDROPREG SR 20 TABLET, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examinations to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

DYDROPREG SR 20 TABLET helps support hormonal balance by mimicking the natural actions of progesterone during the second half (luteal phase) of the menstrual cycle. This can assist in regulating the uterine lining and promoting cycle regularity. Women who experience inconsistent cycles, mid-cycle spotting, or other cycle-related issues due to hormonal imbalances may benefit from its regulated use as advised by their healthcare provider.

Before starting DYDROPREG SR 20 TABLET, it is important to consult a healthcare professional to evaluate the underlying cause of hormonal changes. Usage in pregnancy, breastfeeding, or with other hormonal therapies should always be discussed in advance. Do not take DYDROPREG SR 20 TABLET, if you have any tumours in the body that is worsened by progesterone (meningioma).

The most common side effects of taking DYDROPREG SR 20 TABLET are severe headache, nausea, breast pain or tenderness, and painful, heavy, or irregular periods. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How DYDROPREG SR 20 TABLET Works
Understanding the Role of Dydrogesterone

DYDROPREG SR 20 TABLETcontains Dydrogesterone, a synthetic form of the natural hormone progesterone. It mimics the hormonal activity needed for cycle regulation and supports the environment needed for hormone-responsive conditions. Unlike some other compounds, Dydrogesterone does not have androgenic or estrogenic effects, making it more selective in its action. This tablet is often used in hormone support strategies where balanced progesterone activity is essential.

Is DYDROPREG SR 20 TABLET a natural or synthetic hormone?
DYDROPREG SR 20 TABLET contains dydrogesterone, which is a synthetic hormone. It is a synthetic form of the naturally occurring hormone progesterone
How DYDROPREG SR 20 TABLET may help with menstrual irregularities?

During a normal menstrual cycle, progesterone levels rise in the second half (luteal phase) to prepare the uterus for possible pregnancy. If pregnancy does not occur, progesterone levels drop, triggering menstruation. When the body does not produce enough progesterone, it can lead to irregular or missed periods, spotting, or cycle-related discomfort.

DYDROPREG SR 20 TABLET compensates for this hormonal gap by providing dydrogesterone, which:

Helps maintain the natural rhythm of the menstrual cycle
Supports the uterine lining (endometrium) during the luteal phase
Encourages a predictable withdrawal bleed, simulating a natural period when the tablet is stopped
DYDROPREG SR 20 TABLET uses in Pregnancy: 

It is often prescribed during pregnancy to help maintain a healthy pregnancy, particularly in cases where there is a risk of miscarriage or preterm labor due to progesterone deficiency. It supports the uterine lining, making it more favorable for embryo implantation and helps sustain early pregnancy. DYDROPREG SR 20 TABLET may also be used in women who have a history of recurrent miscarriages or those undergoing fertility management.

DYDROPREG SR 20 TABLET Uses in Menstrual Disorders:

DYDROPREG SR 20 TABLET helps balance hormones, reducing the intense uterine contractions that cause pain during menstruation. By reducing the growth of the endometrial tissue that grows outside the uterus, it relieves pain and discomfort associated with endometriosis. DYDROPREG SR 20 TABLET helps stabilize hormone levels, reducing mood swings, bloating, and other symptoms of PMS.

introduction:
Introduction About METHNIPRED 8 TABLET

METHNIPRED 8 TABLET is used to manage various adrenal gland problems, including adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia, and nonsuppurative thyroiditis. It is also effective in managing autoimmune and inflammatory conditions affecting different parts of the body, such as rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, systemic lupus erythematosus, psoriasis, optic neuritis, uveitis, asthma, and certain blood disorders like leukemia. Additionally, it helps manage inflammatory bowel diseases like Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, as well as tuberculous meningitis in the brain.

This medication is also prescribed for managing severe allergic reactions, including drug-induced hypersensitivity, atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis, and allergic rhinitis. It can prevent graft rejection after organ transplantation and support kidney health by reducing protein loss in the urine or increasing urine output in conditions like nephrotic syndrome.

It contains a medicine called Methylprednisolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids.

Take METHNIPRED 8 TABLET as advised by your physician. Do not stop taking METHNIPRED 8 TABLET or reduce the dose of methylprednisolone without consulting your doctor as it may lead to unpleasant withdrawal symptoms, especially if you are taking higher dose of methylprednisolone.

Before taking METHNIPRED 8 TABLET inform your doctor if you any viral infections, or any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have hypertension, diabetes, thyroid deficiency, glaucoma, skin problem, gut inflammation, muscle problems, osteoporosis, any types of tumors or cancer in the body, depression or any other forms of mental illness.

It should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while taking METHNIPRED 8 TABLET as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of taking METHNIPRED 8 TABLET are high blood pressure, swelling of body parts, muscle cramps or weakness, skin thinning, feeling sad or depressed and slowed growth in children. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience severe depression with suicidal thoughts or severe stomach pain with blood-stained stools or vomit.

It also reduces the release of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes inflammation. It manages graft rejection by suppressing the immune functions and protects your kidney from damage in patients with kidney problems.

Interactions

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before taking METHNIPRED 8 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines such as:

Acetazolamide (a medicine used to manage glaucoma or edema)
Aminoglutethimide or cyclophosphamide (used for managing cancer)
Anticoagulants (used for blood thinning) such as acenocoumarol, phenindione and warfarin
Anti-cholinergic medicines used to manage myasthenia gravis (such as distigmine and neostigmine)
Antibacterials (Ex. isoniazid, erythromycin, clarithromycin and troleandomycin)
Anti diabetics (Ex. metformin, glipizide)
Aprepitant or fosaprepitant (antiemitics)
Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory medicines (used for fever and pain relief) such as aspirin, ibuprofen
Antiepileptics (such as carbamazepine, phenytoin and primidone)
Carbenoxolone and cimetidine (antiulcer agents)
Ciclosporin, tacrolimus (immunosuppressants)
Cardiovascular agents (such as digoxin, diltiazem or mibefradil)
Oral contraceptives (birth control pills) Ex. ethinylestridiol and norethisterone
Medicines used to manage HIV infection (such as ritonavir, indinavir, cobicistat)
Antifungals (such as ketoconazole, amphotericin B, itraconazole)
Muscle relaxants (Ex. pancuronium or vecuronium)
Diuretics (used to manage edema and hypertension) Ex. furosemide, chlorothiazide, hydrochlorothiazide
Medicines used to manage asthma (such as aminophylline, salmeterol, formoterol)
Rifampicin and rifabutin (Antituberculosis)
Live vaccines

B. Drug - Food interaction:

Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while taking METHNIPRED 8 TABLET as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took more METHNIPRED 8 TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital straight away.

introduction:
Introduction About MEPRESSO T 4MG TABLET

MEPRESSO T 4MG TABLET is used to manage various adrenal gland problems, including adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia, and nonsuppurative thyroiditis. It is also effective in managing autoimmune and inflammatory conditions affecting different parts of the body, such as rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, systemic lupus erythematosus, psoriasis, optic neuritis, uveitis, asthma, and certain blood disorders like leukemia. Additionally, it helps manage inflammatory bowel diseases like Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, as well as tuberculous meningitis in the brain.

This medication is also prescribed for managing severe allergic reactions, including drug-induced hypersensitivity, atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis, and allergic rhinitis. It can prevent graft rejection after organ transplantation and support kidney health by reducing protein loss in the urine or increasing urine output in conditions like nephrotic syndrome.

It contains a medicine called Methylprednisolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids.

Take MEPRESSO T 4MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Do not stop taking MEPRESSO T 4MG TABLET or reduce the dose of methylprednisolone without consulting your doctor as it may lead to unpleasant withdrawal symptoms, especially if you are taking higher dose of methylprednisolone.

Before taking MEPRESSO T 4MG TABLET inform your doctor if you any viral infections, or any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have hypertension, diabetes, thyroid deficiency, glaucoma, skin problem, gut inflammation, muscle problems, osteoporosis, any types of tumors or cancer in the body, depression or any other forms of mental illness.

It should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while taking MEPRESSO T 4MG TABLET as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of taking MEPRESSO T 4MG TABLET are high blood pressure, swelling of body parts, muscle cramps or weakness, skin thinning, feeling sad or depressed and slowed growth in children. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience severe depression with suicidal thoughts or severe stomach pain with blood-stained stools or vomit.

mechanismOfAction:
How MEPRESSO T 4MG TABLET Works

MEPRESSO T 4MG TABLET is a corticosteroid medicine with anti-inflammatory and immune suppressant properties. It boosts your body with sufficient corticosteroid levels (cortisol, aldosterone) during deficient conditions and helps your body to function properly.

It also reduces the release of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes inflammation. It manages graft rejection by suppressing the immune functions and protects your kidney from damage in patients with kidney problems.

Do not stop taking MEPRESSO T 4MG TABLET without consulting your doctor.

Introduction About NEODROL 500MG INJECTION

NEODROL 500MG INJECTION is used to manage various adrenal gland problems, including adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia, and nonsuppurative thyroiditis. It is also effective in managing autoimmune and inflammatory conditions affecting different parts of the body, such as rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, systemic lupus erythematosus, psoriasis, optic neuritis, uveitis, asthma, and certain blood disorders like leukemia. Additionally, it helps manage inflammatory bowel diseases like Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, as well as tuberculous meningitis in the brain.

This medication is also prescribed for managing severe allergic reactions, including drug-induced hypersensitivity, atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis, and allergic rhinitis. It can prevent graft rejection after organ transplantation and support kidney health by reducing protein loss in the urine or increasing urine output in conditions like nephrotic syndrome.

It contains Methylprednisolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids.

Before receiving NEODROL 500MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you any viral infections, or any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have hypertension, diabetes, thyroid deficiency, glaucoma, skin problem, gut inflammation, muscle problems, osteoporosis, any types of tumors or cancer in the body, depression or any other forms of mental illness.

NEODROL 500MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe fungal infections, brain swelling due to malaria, or brain injury or stroke. It should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while receiving NEODROL 500MG INJECTION as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of receiving NEODROL 500MG INJECTION are high blood pressure, swelling of body parts, muscle cramps or weakness, skin thinning, feeling sad or depressed and slowed growth in children. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience severe depression with suicidal thoughts or severe stomach pain with blood-stained stools or vomit after receiving it.

mechanismOfAction:
How NEODROL 500MG INJECTION Works

NEODROL 500MG INJECTION is a corticosteroid medicine with anti-inflammatory and immune suppressant properties. It boosts your body with sufficient corticosteroid levels (cortisol, aldosterone) during deficient conditions and helps your body to function properly.

It also reduces the release of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes pain, swelling and inflammation. It manages graft rejection by suppressing the immune functions and protects your kidney from damage in patients with kidney problems.
