Interactions

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before receiving NEODROL 500MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines such as:

Acetazolamide (a medicine used to manage glaucoma or edema)
Aminoglutethimide or cyclophosphamide (used for managing cancer)
Anticoagulants (used for blood thinning) such as acenocoumarol, phenindione and warfarin
Anti-cholinergic medicines used to manage myasthenia gravis (such as distigmine and neostigmine)
Antibacterials (Ex. isoniazid, erythromycin, clarithromycin and troleandomycin)
Anti diabetics (Ex. metformin, glipizide)
Aprepitant or fosaprepitant (antiemitics)
Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory medicines (used for fever and pain relief) such as aspirin, ibuprofen
Antiepileptics (such as carbamazepine, phenytoin and primidone)
Carbenoxolone and cimetidine (antiulcer agents)
Ciclosporin, tacrolimus (immunosuppressants)
Cardiovascular agents (such as digoxin, diltiazem or mibefradil)
Oral contraceptives (birth control pills) Ex. ethinylestridiol and norethisterone
Medicines used to manage HIV infection (such as ritonavir, indinavir, cobicistat)
Antifungals (such as ketoconazole, amphotericin B, itraconazole)
Muscle relaxants (Ex. pancuronium or vecuronium)
Diuretics (used to manage edema and hypertension) Ex. furosemide, chlorothiazide, hydrochlorothiazide
Medicines used to manage asthma (such as aminophylline, salmeterol, formoterol)
Rifampicin and rifabutin (Antituberculosis)
Live vaccines

B. Drug - Food interaction:

Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while undergoing therapy with NEODROL 500MG INJECTION as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

Overdosage:

NEODROL 500MG INJECTION will be administered to you only by a doctor or a nurse in a hospital, and so it is unlikely to receive an overdose. However, consult your doctor or nurse if you experience any unusual symptoms.

Introduction About SOLU MEDROL 1GM INJECTION

SOLU MEDROL 1GM INJECTION is used to manage various adrenal gland problems, including adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia, and nonsuppurative thyroiditis. It is also effective in managing autoimmune and inflammatory conditions affecting different parts of the body, such as rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, systemic lupus erythematosus, psoriasis, optic neuritis, uveitis, asthma, and certain blood disorders like leukemia. Additionally, it helps manage inflammatory bowel diseases like Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, as well as tuberculous meningitis in the brain.

This medication is also prescribed for managing severe allergic reactions, including drug-induced hypersensitivity, atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis, and allergic rhinitis. It can prevent graft rejection after organ transplantation and support kidney health by reducing protein loss in the urine or increasing urine output in conditions like nephrotic syndrome.

It contains Methylprednisolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids.

Before receiving SOLU MEDROL 1GM INJECTION inform your doctor if you any viral infections, or any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have hypertension, diabetes, thyroid deficiency, glaucoma, skin problem, gut inflammation, muscle problems, osteoporosis, any types of tumors or cancer in the body, depression or any other forms of mental illness.

SOLU MEDROL 1GM INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe fungal infections, brain swelling due to malaria, or brain injury or stroke. It should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while receiving SOLU MEDROL 1GM INJECTION as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of receiving SOLU MEDROL 1GM INJECTION are high blood pressure, swelling of body parts, muscle cramps or weakness, skin thinning, feeling sad or depressed and slowed growth in children. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience severe depression with suicidal thoughts or severe stomach pain with blood-stained stools or vomit after receiving it.

mechanismOfAction:
How SOLU MEDROL 1GM INJECTION Works

SOLU MEDROL 1GM INJECTION is a corticosteroid medicine with anti-inflammatory and immune suppressant properties. It boosts your body with sufficient corticosteroid levels (cortisol, aldosterone) during deficient conditions and helps your body to function properly.

It also reduces the release of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes pain, swelling and inflammation. It manages graft rejection by suppressing the immune functions and protects your kidney from damage in patients with kidney problems.

It also reduces the release of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes inflammation. It manages graft rejection by suppressing the immune functions and protects your kidney from damage in patients with kidney problems.

Interactions

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before taking IVEPRED 16MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines such as:

Acetazolamide (a medicine used to manage glaucoma or edema)
Aminoglutethimide or cyclophosphamide (used for managing cancer)
Anticoagulants (used for blood thinning) such as acenocoumarol, phenindione and warfarin
Anti-cholinergic medicines used to manage myasthenia gravis (such as distigmine and neostigmine)
Antibacterials (Ex. isoniazid, erythromycin, clarithromycin and troleandomycin)
Anti diabetics (Ex. metformin, glipizide)
Aprepitant or fosaprepitant (antiemitics)
Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory medicines (used for fever and pain relief) such as aspirin, ibuprofen
Antiepileptics (such as carbamazepine, phenytoin and primidone)
Carbenoxolone and cimetidine (antiulcer agents)
Ciclosporin, tacrolimus (immunosuppressants)
Cardiovascular agents (such as digoxin, diltiazem or mibefradil)
Oral contraceptives (birth control pills) Ex. ethinylestridiol and norethisterone
Medicines used to manage HIV infection (such as ritonavir, indinavir, cobicistat)
Antifungals (such as ketoconazole, amphotericin B, itraconazole)
Muscle relaxants (Ex. pancuronium or vecuronium)
Diuretics (used to manage edema and hypertension) Ex. furosemide, chlorothiazide, hydrochlorothiazide
Medicines used to manage asthma (such as aminophylline, salmeterol, formoterol)

Live vaccines

Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while taking IVEPRED 16MG TABLET as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

If you or anyone else accidentally took more IVEPRED 16MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital straight away.

introduction:
Introduction About ZEN MPS 16MG TABLET

ZEN MPS 16MG TABLET is used to manage various adrenal gland problems, including adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia, and nonsuppurative thyroiditis. It is also effective in managing autoimmune and inflammatory conditions affecting different parts of the body, such as rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, systemic lupus erythematosus, psoriasis, optic neuritis, uveitis, asthma, and certain blood disorders like leukemia. Additionally, it helps manage inflammatory bowel diseases like Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, as well as tuberculous meningitis in the brain.

This medication is also prescribed for managing severe allergic reactions, including drug-induced hypersensitivity, atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis, and allergic rhinitis. It can prevent graft rejection after organ transplantation and support kidney health by reducing protein loss in the urine or increasing urine output in conditions like nephrotic syndrome.

It contains a medicine called Methylprednisolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids.

Take ZEN MPS 16MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Do not stop taking ZEN MPS 16MG TABLET or reduce the dose of methylprednisolone without consulting your doctor as it may lead to unpleasant withdrawal symptoms, especially if you are taking higher dose of methylprednisolone.

Before taking ZEN MPS 16MG TABLET inform your doctor if you any viral infections, or any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have hypertension, diabetes, thyroid deficiency, glaucoma, skin problem, gut inflammation, muscle problems, osteoporosis, any types of tumors or cancer in the body, depression or any other forms of mental illness.

It should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while taking ZEN MPS 16MG TABLET as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of taking ZEN MPS 16MG TABLET are high blood pressure, swelling of body parts, muscle cramps or weakness, skin thinning, feeling sad or depressed and slowed growth in children. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience severe depression with suicidal thoughts or severe stomach pain with blood-stained stools or vomit.

introduction:
Introduction About IVEPRED 500MG INJECTION

IVEPRED 500MG INJECTION is used to manage various adrenal gland problems, including adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia, and nonsuppurative thyroiditis. It is also effective in managing autoimmune and inflammatory conditions affecting different parts of the body, such as rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, systemic lupus erythematosus, psoriasis, optic neuritis, uveitis, asthma, and certain blood disorders like leukemia. Additionally, it helps manage inflammatory bowel diseases like Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, as well as tuberculous meningitis in the brain.

This medication is also prescribed for managing severe allergic reactions, including drug-induced hypersensitivity, atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis, and allergic rhinitis. It can prevent graft rejection after organ transplantation and support kidney health by reducing protein loss in the urine or increasing urine output in conditions like nephrotic syndrome.

It contains Methylprednisolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids.

Before receiving IVEPRED 500MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you any viral infections, or any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have hypertension, diabetes, thyroid deficiency, glaucoma, skin problem, gut inflammation, muscle problems, osteoporosis, any types of tumors or cancer in the body, depression or any other forms of mental illness.

IVEPRED 500MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe fungal infections, brain swelling due to malaria, or brain injury or stroke. It should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while receiving IVEPRED 500MG INJECTION as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of receiving IVEPRED 500MG INJECTION are high blood pressure, swelling of body parts, muscle cramps or weakness, skin thinning, feeling sad or depressed and slowed growth in children. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience severe depression with suicidal thoughts or severe stomach pain with blood-stained stools or vomit after receiving it.

mechanismOfAction:
How IVEPRED 500MG INJECTION Works

IVEPRED 500MG INJECTION is a corticosteroid medicine with anti-inflammatory and immune suppressant properties. It boosts your body with sufficient corticosteroid levels (cortisol, aldosterone) during deficient conditions and helps your body to function properly.

It also reduces the release of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes pain, swelling and inflammation. It manages graft rejection by suppressing the immune functions and protects your kidney from damage in patients with kidney problems.

introduction:
Introduction About MEPRESSO I 1GM INJECTION

MEPRESSO I 1GM INJECTION is used to manage various adrenal gland problems, including adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia, and nonsuppurative thyroiditis. It is also effective in managing autoimmune and inflammatory conditions affecting different parts of the body, such as rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, systemic lupus erythematosus, psoriasis, optic neuritis, uveitis, asthma, and certain blood disorders like leukemia. Additionally, it helps manage inflammatory bowel diseases like Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, as well as tuberculous meningitis in the brain.

This medication is also prescribed for managing severe allergic reactions, including drug-induced hypersensitivity, atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis, and allergic rhinitis. It can prevent graft rejection after organ transplantation and support kidney health by reducing protein loss in the urine or increasing urine output in conditions like nephrotic syndrome.

It contains Methylprednisolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids.

Before receiving MEPRESSO I 1GM INJECTION inform your doctor if you any viral infections, or any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have hypertension, diabetes, thyroid deficiency, glaucoma, skin problem, gut inflammation, muscle problems, osteoporosis, any types of tumors or cancer in the body, depression or any other forms of mental illness.

MEPRESSO I 1GM INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe fungal infections, brain swelling due to malaria, or brain injury or stroke. It should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while receiving MEPRESSO I 1GM INJECTION as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of receiving MEPRESSO I 1GM INJECTION are high blood pressure, swelling of body parts, muscle cramps or weakness, skin thinning, feeling sad or depressed and slowed growth in children. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience severe depression with suicidal thoughts or severe stomach pain with blood-stained stools or vomit after receiving it.

mechanismOfAction:
How MEPRESSO I 1GM INJECTION Works

MEPRESSO I 1GM INJECTION is a corticosteroid medicine with anti-inflammatory and immune suppressant properties. It boosts your body with sufficient corticosteroid levels (cortisol, aldosterone) during deficient conditions and helps your body to function properly.

It also reduces the release of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes pain, swelling and inflammation. It manages graft rejection by suppressing the immune functions and protects your kidney from damage in patients with kidney problems.

How to use MEPRESSO I 1GM INJECTION

MEPRESSO I 1GM INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the muscle (intramuscularly) or into the vein (intravenously). Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Interactions

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before taking NUCORT M 16MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines such as:

Acetazolamide (a medicine used to manage glaucoma or edema)
Aminoglutethimide or cyclophosphamide (used for managing cancer)
Anticoagulants (used for blood thinning) such as acenocoumarol, phenindione and warfarin
Anti-cholinergic medicines used to manage myasthenia gravis (such as distigmine and neostigmine)
Antibacterials (Ex. isoniazid, erythromycin, clarithromycin and troleandomycin)
Anti diabetics (Ex. metformin, glipizide)
Aprepitant or fosaprepitant (antiemitics)
Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory medicines (used for fever and pain relief) such as aspirin, ibuprofen
Antiepileptics (such as carbamazepine, phenytoin and primidone)
Carbenoxolone and cimetidine (antiulcer agents)
Ciclosporin, tacrolimus (immunosuppressants)
Cardiovascular agents (such as digoxin, diltiazem or mibefradil)
Oral contraceptives (birth control pills) Ex. ethinylestridiol and norethisterone
Medicines used to manage HIV infection (such as ritonavir, indinavir, cobicistat)
Antifungals (such as ketoconazole, amphotericin B, itraconazole)
Muscle relaxants (Ex. pancuronium or vecuronium)
Diuretics (used to manage edema and hypertension) Ex. furosemide, chlorothiazide, hydrochlorothiazide
Medicines used to manage asthma (such as aminophylline, salmeterol, formoterol)
Rifampicin and rifabutin (Antituberculosis)
Live vaccines

introduction:
Introduction About IVEPRED 125MG INJECTION

IVEPRED 125MG INJECTION is used to manage various adrenal gland problems, including adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia, and nonsuppurative thyroiditis. It is also effective in managing autoimmune and inflammatory conditions affecting different parts of the body, such as rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, systemic lupus erythematosus, psoriasis, optic neuritis, uveitis, asthma, and certain blood disorders like leukemia. Additionally, it helps manage inflammatory bowel diseases like Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, as well as tuberculous meningitis in the brain.

This medication is also prescribed for managing severe allergic reactions, including drug-induced hypersensitivity, atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis, and allergic rhinitis. It can prevent graft rejection after organ transplantation and support kidney health by reducing protein loss in the urine or increasing urine output in conditions like nephrotic syndrome.

It contains Methylprednisolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids.

Before receiving IVEPRED 125MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you any viral infections, or any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have hypertension, diabetes, thyroid deficiency, glaucoma, skin problem, gut inflammation, muscle problems, osteoporosis, any types of tumors or cancer in the body, depression or any other forms of mental illness.

IVEPRED 125MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe fungal infections, brain swelling due to malaria, or brain injury or stroke. It should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while receiving IVEPRED 125MG INJECTION as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of receiving IVEPRED 125MG INJECTION are high blood pressure, swelling of body parts, muscle cramps or weakness, skin thinning, feeling sad or depressed and slowed growth in children. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience severe depression with suicidal thoughts or severe stomach pain with blood-stained stools or vomit after receiving it.

mechanismOfAction:
How IVEPRED 125MG INJECTION Works

IVEPRED 125MG INJECTION is a corticosteroid medicine with anti-inflammatory and immune suppressant properties. It boosts your body with sufficient corticosteroid levels (cortisol, aldosterone) during deficient conditions and helps your body to function properly.

It also reduces the release of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes pain, swelling and inflammation. It manages graft rejection by suppressing the immune functions and protects your kidney from damage in patients with kidney problems.

IVEPRED 125MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the muscle (intramuscularly) or into the vein (intravenously). Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About DEMISONE TABLET

DEMISONE TABLET contains Dexamethasone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids. It is used to manage problematic conditions of the adrenal glands (such as adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia and nonsuppurative thyroiditis)

It can also be used to manage various inflammatory auto-immune disease conditions affecting the bones and joints (Ex. rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis), skin and collagen (Ex. Stevens-Johnson syndrome, psoriasis), eyes (Ex. optic neuritis, uveitis or iritis), respiratory tract (Ex. asthma, pneumonitis, tuberculosis), blood and lymph (Ex. leukaemia, anemia, thrombocytopenia, blood cancer, lymph cancer, sarcoidosis), bowel and gut (Ex. Crohn’s disease and ulcerative colitis), brain (Ex. tuberculous meningitis, cerebral edema associated with brain tumor) and heart (inflammation of heart membranes)

It is also indicated in the management of drug induced hypersensitivity reactions and in other allergic reactions (such as atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis and allergic rhinitis). It also corrects calcium levels among cancer patients and increases urine output or reduces protein loss via urine among patients having kidney problems (such as nephrotic syndrome).

Before taking DEMISONE TABLET inform your doctor if you any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension, glaucoma, epilepsy, underactive thyroid, muscle problems, osteoporosis, stomach problems, tuberculosis, depression, mania or any other mental problems as a precaution.

DEMISONE TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with serious unmanageed fungal or viral infections in the body. Do not take DEMISONE TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking DEMISONE TABLET are headache, dizziness, acne, stomach discomfort, slow wound healing, skin thinning, high blood pressure, fluid retention, swelling and weight gain of the body and face, high blood sugar levels, muscle weakness, bone thinning and irregular menstrual periods. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About DEXAVAC INJECTION

DEXAVAC INJECTION contains Dexamethasone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids. It is used to manage problematic conditions of the adrenal glands (such as adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia and nonsuppurative thyroiditis).

It can also be used to manage various inflammatory auto-immune disease conditions affecting the bones and joints (Ex. rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis), skin and collagen (Ex. Stevens-Johnson syndrome, psoriasis), eyes (Ex. optic neuritis, uveitis or iritis), respiratory tract (Ex. asthma, pneumonitis, tuberculosis), blood and lymph (Ex. leukaemia, anemia, thrombocytopenia, blood cancer, lymph cancer, sarcoidosis), bowel and gut (Ex. Crohn’s disease and ulcerative colitis), brain (Ex. tuberculous meningitis, cerebral edema associated with brain tumor, increased pressure within the skull) and heart (inflammation of heart membranes).

It is also indicated in the management of drug induced hypersensitivity reactions and in other allergic reactions (such as atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis and allergic rhinitis). It also corrects calcium levels among cancer patients and increases urine output or reduces protein loss via urine among patients having kidney problems (such as nephrotic syndrome).

Before receiving DEXAVAC INJECTION inform your doctor if you any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension, glaucoma, epilepsy, underactive thyroid, muscle problems, osteoporosis, stomach problems, tuberculosis, depression, mania or any other mental problems as a precaution.

DEXAVAC INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with serious unmanageed infections in the body or bone problems. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women.

The most common side effects of receiving DEXAVAC INJECTION are headache, dizziness, acne, stomach discomfort, slow wound healing, skin thinning, high blood pressure, fluid retention, swelling and weight gain of the body and face, high blood sugar levels, muscle weakness, bone thinning and irregular menstrual periods. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About BETMARC S TABLET

BETMARC S TABLET is used to manage many different types of conditions, including asthma and severe allergic reactions, certain conditions of the blood, rheumatoid arthritis (chronic inflammatory diseases affecting the joints), autoimmune diseases (like systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) and polyarteritis nodosa), inflammatory conditions of the skin, kidney (like acute interstitial nephritis), bowels (like ulcerative colitis and Crohn's disease), and heart, some connective tissue disorders, and malignant lymphoma. BETMARC S TABLET also helps to manage organ transplant rejection following organ transplant surgery.

It contains Betamethasone, which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids that work by inhibiting the formation of prostaglandins in the body, which are responsible for pain and inflammation.

Take BETMARC S TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with enough water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take BETMARC S TABLET daily at the same time.

Your doctor might recommend you take relevant tests to understand your condition before starting management with BETMARC S TABLET. Avoid drinking alcohol while using BETMARC S TABLET, as it may worsen your existing condition.

BETMARC S TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with an infection who are not taking antibiotics. Before taking BETMARC S TABLET, inform your doctor if you have kidney, liver, heart problems, an underactive thyroid gland, a severe mental illness, tuberculosis, epilepsy, hypertension, pheochromocytoma, glaucoma, or diabetes.

BETMARC S TABLET should be used with caution among women who are pregnant or breastfeeding. BETMARC S TABLET should be used with caution in children, adolescents, and elderly patients. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen. Consult with your doctor if you experience any unusual behaviours, self-harm, depression, etc., after taking BETMARC S TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About DEXASONE 0.5MG TABLET

DEXASONE 0.5MG TABLET contains Dexamethasone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids. It is used to manage problematic conditions of the adrenal glands (such as adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia and nonsuppurative thyroiditis)

It can also be used to manage various inflammatory auto-immune disease conditions affecting the bones and joints (Ex. rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis), skin and collagen (Ex. Stevens-Johnson syndrome, psoriasis), eyes (Ex. optic neuritis, uveitis or iritis), respiratory tract (Ex. asthma, pneumonitis, tuberculosis), blood and lymph (Ex. leukaemia, anemia, thrombocytopenia, blood cancer, lymph cancer, sarcoidosis), bowel and gut (Ex. Crohn’s disease and ulcerative colitis), brain (Ex. tuberculous meningitis, cerebral edema associated with brain tumor) and heart (inflammation of heart membranes)

It is also indicated in the management of drug induced hypersensitivity reactions and in other allergic reactions (such as atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis and allergic rhinitis). It also corrects calcium levels among cancer patients and increases urine output or reduces protein loss via urine among patients having kidney problems (such as nephrotic syndrome).

Before taking DEXASONE 0.5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension, glaucoma, epilepsy, underactive thyroid, muscle problems, osteoporosis, stomach problems, tuberculosis, depression, mania or any other mental problems as a precaution.

DEXASONE 0.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with serious unmanageed fungal or viral infections in the body. Do not take DEXASONE 0.5MG TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking DEXASONE 0.5MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, acne, stomach discomfort, slow wound healing, skin thinning, high blood pressure, fluid retention, swelling and weight gain of the body and face, high blood sugar levels, muscle weakness, bone thinning and irregular menstrual periods. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How DEXASONE 0.5MG TABLET Works

DEXASONE 0.5MG TABLET is a steroid medicine with anti-inflammatory and immune suppressant properties. It boosts your body with sufficient corticosteroid levels (cortisol, aldosterone) during deficient conditions and helps your body to function properly.

It also reduces the release of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes inflammation, pain, irritation and swelling. As a result, it reduces allergic and inflammatory conditions in the body.
usageDetails:
How to use DEXASONE 0.5MG TABLET

Take DEXASONE 0.5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It must be taken with or just after meals to manage stomach upset.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking DEXASONE 0.5MG TABLET without consulting your doctor.

name: CORTIVAC Cream 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About CORTIVAC CREAM

CORTIVAC CREAM contains Hydrocortisone acetate which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids. CORTIVAC CREAM is used to manage all types of eczema (type of skin inflammation), dermatitis (itching) and insect bite reactions in affected individuals.  

CORTIVAC CREAM is not recommended for use in patients allergic to hydrocortisone. It is also not recommended for use in patients with unmanageed skin infection, urticaria (red itchy welts), rosacea (red pus-filled bumps on face), ulcers/infections at the site of management, and psoriasis (itchy skin).

Before applying CORTIVAC CREAM, inform your doctor if you smoke, and/or have tuberculosis, diabetes, and liver disease.

CORTIVAC CREAM should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women. The medicine is also advised to be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). CORTIVAC CREAM can also be used in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.  

The most common side effects of applying CORTIVAC CREAM are atrophy (thinning of muscle tissue), stretch marks, rosacea (red pus-filled bumps on face), perioral dermatitis (inflammation of skin around mouth), acne, and/or purpura (purple coloured rash). Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.
uses: Manage all types of eczema, dermatitis, and insect bite reactions in affected individuals
usesDetails:

Manage all types of eczema, dermatitis, and insect bite reactions in affected individuals
mechanismOfAction:
How CORTIVAC CREAM Works

CORTIVAC CREAM works by blocking the production of certain chemical messengers (responsible for inflammation and allergies) in the body which results in providing relief from eczema, dermatitis, and insect bite reactions in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use CORTIVAC CREAM

Always apply CORTIVAC CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Apply a thin layer of this medicine on the affected area. Managed areas on the face should not  be covered with a plaster/bandage. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including eyelids. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Acucort 100mg Injection 1's
introduction:
Introduction About ACUCORT 100MG INJECTION

ACUCORT 100MG INJECTION contains Hydrocortisone, which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids. ACUCORT 100MG INJECTION is used to manage endocrine disorders (diseases of endocrine glands), rheumatic disorders (inflammatory and autoimmune diseases), and hematologic disorders (blood disorders) in affected individuals.

It is also used to manage collagen diseases (autoimmune disease), dermatologic diseases, ophthalmic diseases, gastrointestinal diseases, respiratory diseases, and neoplastic diseases. The medicine is also indicated for use to replace insufficient corticosteroid hormone and manage edematous and allergic states and medical emergencies (such as shock or severe allergic reactions) in affected individuals.

ACUCORT 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to hydrocortisone. It is also not recommended for use in patients with systemic fungal infections, viral infections (such as herpes simplex eye infection, vaccinia, varicella), and idiopathic thrombocytopenic purpura (a blood disorder marked by low platelet levels). The medicine is also not indicated for use in patients who have recently received live-attenuated vaccines.

Before receiving ACUCORT 100MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have/have had an infection (such as herpes simplex, chickenpox, tuberculosis, threadworm), bleeding/clotting problem, suffering from osteoporosis (brittle bone), high blood pressure, oedema (swelling in arms/legs), diabetes, kidney problems (such as renal insufficiency), and/or liver problems (such as cirrhosis).

ACUCORT 100MG INJECTION should be administered with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.

ACUCORT 100MG INJECTION should be administered with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). If the medicine is to be received for a longer period of time, then frequent tests on the child need to be conducted to manage the risk of developing high intracranial pressure in the child. The medicine is advised to be administered with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects associated with the use of ACUCORT 100MG INJECTION are pain and swelling at the site of injection. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

How ACUCORT 100MG INJECTION Works

ACUCORT 100MG INJECTION works by replacing insufficient cortisol (naturally produced steroid) levels and blocks the production of certain chemical messengers (responsible for inflammation and allergies) in the body, which results in decreased swelling and provides relief from inflammation and pain in affected individuals.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of ACUCORT 100MG INJECTION for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

Are administered with live attenuated vaccines
Are suffering from viral infections such as herpes simplex eye infection (a potentially serious type of eye infection), vaccinia, and varicella

Have/have had an infection (such as herpes simplex, chickenpox, tuberculosis, threadworm)

Have/had stomach or gut problems such as ulcer or ulcerative colitis
Are suffering from low potassium/calcium levels in the blood
Have a weak immune response
Are scheduled for a surgery

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before receiving ACUCORT 100MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Aspirin (used to reduce fever and relieve pain)
Amphotericin B (used to manage serious and potentially life-threatening fungal infections)
Isoniazid (used to manage or manage recurrence of tuberculosis)
Rifampicin (medicine used to manage tuberculosis)
Erythromycin, clarithromycin, and oleandomycin (medicines used to manage bacterial infections)
Anticoagulants (used to manage blood clots) Ex. rivaroxaban, dabigatran
Anticonvulsants (medicines used to manage seizures) Ex. carbamazepine
Barbiturates (sedative-hypnotic medication used to manage seizures) Ex. phenobarbital, phenytoin
Neuromuscular blockers (used in anesthesia to facilitate endotracheal intubation) Ex. rocuronium, vecuronium
Anticholinesterase (medicines used to manage Alzheimer disease) Ex. galantamine, donepezil
Antidiabetics (medicines used to manage diabetes) Ex. insulin, metformin
Antiemetics (medicines used to ease nausea and vomiting) Ex. aprepitant, fosaprepitant
Antifungals (medicines used to manage fungal infections) Ex. itraconazole, ketoconazole
HIV protease inhibitors (medicines used to manage HIV) Ex. atazanavir, darunavir 
Aromatase inhibitors (used to manage breast cancer) Ex. aminoglutethimide
Calcium channel blocker (used to manage low blood pressure) Ex. diltiazem
Cardiac glycosides (used to manage heart failure and irregular heartbeats) Ex. digoxin
Cholestyramine (used to lower high cholesterol levels in the blood)
Oral contraceptives (used to manage pregnancy) Ex. estrogens
Somatropin (used to manage growth failure)
Cyclosporine (used to manage organ transplant failure)
Immunosuppressant (used to stop your immune system from attacking health cells) Ex. cyclophosphamide, tacrolimus
Diuretics (used to manage low blood pressure) Ex. chlorothiazide, chlorthalidone
Beta2 agonists (used to manage asthma and COPD) Ex. salbutamol, terbutaline
Vaccines (used to boost the immune system) Ex. chickenpox vaccine

B. Drug-Food interaction:

Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking ACUCORT 100MG INJECTION, as it may cause steroid toxicity.

Overdosage:

ACUCORT 100MG INJECTION will be administered to you only by a doctor or a nurse in a hospital, and so you are unlikely to receive an overdose. However, consult your doctor or nurse if you experience any unusual symptoms.

introduction:
Introduction About MEPRESSO T 16MG TABLET

MEPRESSO T 16MG TABLET is used to manage various adrenal gland problems, including adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia, and nonsuppurative thyroiditis. It is also effective in managing autoimmune and inflammatory conditions affecting different parts of the body, such as rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, systemic lupus erythematosus, psoriasis, optic neuritis, uveitis, asthma, and certain blood disorders like leukemia. Additionally, it helps manage inflammatory bowel diseases like Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, as well as tuberculous meningitis in the brain.

This medication is also prescribed for managing severe allergic reactions, including drug-induced hypersensitivity, atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis, and allergic rhinitis. It can prevent graft rejection after organ transplantation and support kidney health by reducing protein loss in the urine or increasing urine output in conditions like nephrotic syndrome.

It contains a medicine called Methylprednisolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids.

Take MEPRESSO T 16MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Do not stop taking MEPRESSO T 16MG TABLET or reduce the dose of methylprednisolone without consulting your doctor as it may lead to unpleasant withdrawal symptoms, especially if you are taking higher dose of methylprednisolone.

Before taking MEPRESSO T 16MG TABLET inform your doctor if you any viral infections, or any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have hypertension, diabetes, thyroid deficiency, glaucoma, skin problem, gut inflammation, muscle problems, osteoporosis, any types of tumors or cancer in the body, depression or any other forms of mental illness.

It should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while taking MEPRESSO T 16MG TABLET as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of taking MEPRESSO T 16MG TABLET are high blood pressure, swelling of body parts, muscle cramps or weakness, skin thinning, feeling sad or depressed and slowed growth in children. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience severe depression with suicidal thoughts or severe stomach pain with blood-stained stools or vomit.

mechanismOfAction:
How MEPRESSO T 16MG TABLET Works

MEPRESSO T 16MG TABLET is a corticosteroid medicine with anti-inflammatory and immune suppressant properties. It boosts your body with sufficient corticosteroid levels (cortisol, aldosterone) during deficient conditions and helps your body to function properly.

It also reduces the release of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes inflammation. It manages graft rejection by suppressing the immune functions and protects your kidney from damage in patients with kidney problems.

introduction:
Introduction About ZYPRED 40 INJECTION

ZYPRED 40 INJECTION is used to manage various adrenal gland problems, including adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia, and nonsuppurative thyroiditis. It is also effective in managing autoimmune and inflammatory conditions affecting different parts of the body, such as rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, systemic lupus erythematosus, psoriasis, optic neuritis, uveitis, asthma, and certain blood disorders like leukemia. Additionally, it helps manage inflammatory bowel diseases like Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, as well as tuberculous meningitis in the brain.

This medication is also prescribed for managing severe allergic reactions, including drug-induced hypersensitivity, atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis, and allergic rhinitis. It can prevent graft rejection after organ transplantation and support kidney health by reducing protein loss in the urine or increasing urine output in conditions like nephrotic syndrome.

It contains Methylprednisolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids.

Before receiving ZYPRED 40 INJECTION inform your doctor if you any viral infections, or any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have hypertension, diabetes, thyroid deficiency, glaucoma, skin problem, gut inflammation, muscle problems, osteoporosis, any types of tumors or cancer in the body, depression or any other forms of mental illness.

ZYPRED 40 INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe fungal infections, brain swelling due to malaria, or brain injury or stroke. It should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while receiving ZYPRED 40 INJECTION as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of receiving ZYPRED 40 INJECTION are high blood pressure, swelling of body parts, muscle cramps or weakness, skin thinning, feeling sad or depressed and slowed growth in children. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience severe depression with suicidal thoughts or severe stomach pain with blood-stained stools or vomit after receiving it.

mechanismOfAction:
How ZYPRED 40 INJECTION Works

ZYPRED 40 INJECTION is a corticosteroid medicine with anti-inflammatory and immune suppressant properties. It boosts your body with sufficient corticosteroid levels (cortisol, aldosterone) during deficient conditions and helps your body to function properly.

It also reduces the release of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes pain, swelling and inflammation. It manages graft rejection by suppressing the immune functions and protects your kidney from damage in patients with kidney problems.

introduction:
Introduction About MACPRED 125MG INJECTION

MACPRED 125MG INJECTION is used to manage various adrenal gland problems, including adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia, and nonsuppurative thyroiditis. It is also effective in managing autoimmune and inflammatory conditions affecting different parts of the body, such as rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, systemic lupus erythematosus, psoriasis, optic neuritis, uveitis, asthma, and certain blood disorders like leukemia. Additionally, it helps manage inflammatory bowel diseases like Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, as well as tuberculous meningitis in the brain.

This medication is also prescribed for managing severe allergic reactions, including drug-induced hypersensitivity, atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis, and allergic rhinitis. It can prevent graft rejection after organ transplantation and support kidney health by reducing protein loss in the urine or increasing urine output in conditions like nephrotic syndrome.

It contains Methylprednisolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids.

Before receiving MACPRED 125MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you any viral infections, or any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have hypertension, diabetes, thyroid deficiency, glaucoma, skin problem, gut inflammation, muscle problems, osteoporosis, any types of tumors or cancer in the body, depression or any other forms of mental illness.

MACPRED 125MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe fungal infections, brain swelling due to malaria, or brain injury or stroke. It should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while receiving MACPRED 125MG INJECTION as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of receiving MACPRED 125MG INJECTION are high blood pressure, swelling of body parts, muscle cramps or weakness, skin thinning, feeling sad or depressed and slowed growth in children. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience severe depression with suicidal thoughts or severe stomach pain with blood-stained stools or vomit after receiving it.

mechanismOfAction:
How MACPRED 125MG INJECTION Works

MACPRED 125MG INJECTION is a corticosteroid medicine with anti-inflammatory and immune suppressant properties. It boosts your body with sufficient corticosteroid levels (cortisol, aldosterone) during deficient conditions and helps your body to function properly.

It also reduces the release of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes pain, swelling and inflammation. It manages graft rejection by suppressing the immune functions and protects your kidney from damage in patients with kidney problems.

MACPRED 125MG INJECTION will be administered to you only by a doctor or a nurse in a hospital, and so it is unlikely to receive an overdose. However, consult your doctor or nurse if you experience any unusual symptoms.

introduction:
Introduction About HYDROCORT 100MG INJECTION

HYDROCORT 100MG INJECTION contains Hydrocortisone, which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids. HYDROCORT 100MG INJECTION is used to manage endocrine disorders (diseases of endocrine glands), rheumatic disorders (inflammatory and autoimmune diseases), and hematologic disorders (blood disorders) in affected individuals.

It is also used to manage collagen diseases (autoimmune disease), dermatologic diseases, ophthalmic diseases, gastrointestinal diseases, respiratory diseases, and neoplastic diseases. The medicine is also indicated for use to replace insufficient corticosteroid hormone and manage edematous and allergic states and medical emergencies (such as shock or severe allergic reactions) in affected individuals.

HYDROCORT 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to hydrocortisone. It is also not recommended for use in patients with systemic fungal infections, viral infections (such as herpes simplex eye infection, vaccinia, varicella), and idiopathic thrombocytopenic purpura (a blood disorder marked by low platelet levels). The medicine is also not indicated for use in patients who have recently received live-attenuated vaccines.

Before receiving HYDROCORT 100MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have/have had an infection (such as herpes simplex, chickenpox, tuberculosis, threadworm), bleeding/clotting problem, suffering from osteoporosis (brittle bone), high blood pressure, oedema (swelling in arms/legs), diabetes, kidney problems (such as renal insufficiency), and/or liver problems (such as cirrhosis).

HYDROCORT 100MG INJECTION should be administered with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.

HYDROCORT 100MG INJECTION should be administered with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). If the medicine is to be received for a longer period of time, then frequent tests on the child need to be conducted to manage the risk of developing high intracranial pressure in the child. The medicine is advised to be administered with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects associated with the use of HYDROCORT 100MG INJECTION are pain and swelling at the site of injection. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About METHYLCORTIL 8MG TABLET

METHYLCORTIL 8MG TABLET is used to manage various adrenal gland problems, including adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia, and nonsuppurative thyroiditis. It is also effective in managing autoimmune and inflammatory conditions affecting different parts of the body, such as rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, systemic lupus erythematosus, psoriasis, optic neuritis, uveitis, asthma, and certain blood disorders like leukemia. Additionally, it helps manage inflammatory bowel diseases like Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, as well as tuberculous meningitis in the brain.

This medication is also prescribed for managing severe allergic reactions, including drug-induced hypersensitivity, atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis, and allergic rhinitis. It can prevent graft rejection after organ transplantation and support kidney health by reducing protein loss in the urine or increasing urine output in conditions like nephrotic syndrome.

It contains a medicine called Methylprednisolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids.

Take METHYLCORTIL 8MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Do not stop taking METHYLCORTIL 8MG TABLET or reduce the dose of methylprednisolone without consulting your doctor as it may lead to unpleasant withdrawal symptoms, especially if you are taking higher dose of methylprednisolone.

Before taking METHYLCORTIL 8MG TABLET inform your doctor if you any viral infections, or any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have hypertension, diabetes, thyroid deficiency, glaucoma, skin problem, gut inflammation, muscle problems, osteoporosis, any types of tumors or cancer in the body, depression or any other forms of mental illness.

It should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while taking METHYLCORTIL 8MG TABLET as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of taking METHYLCORTIL 8MG TABLET are high blood pressure, swelling of body parts, muscle cramps or weakness, skin thinning, feeling sad or depressed and slowed growth in children. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience severe depression with suicidal thoughts or severe stomach pain with blood-stained stools or vomit.

mechanismOfAction:
How METHYLCORTIL 8MG TABLET Works

METHYLCORTIL 8MG TABLET is a corticosteroid medicine with anti-inflammatory and immune suppressant properties. It boosts your body with sufficient corticosteroid levels (cortisol, aldosterone) during deficient conditions and helps your body to function properly.

It also reduces the release of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes inflammation. It manages graft rejection by suppressing the immune functions and protects your kidney from damage in patients with kidney problems.

Introduction About DEXAMETHASONE(LIFE) INJECTION

DEXAMETHASONE(LIFE) INJECTION contains Dexamethasone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids. It is used to manage problematic conditions of the adrenal glands (such as adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia and nonsuppurative thyroiditis).

It can also be used to manage various inflammatory auto-immune disease conditions affecting the bones and joints (Ex. rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis), skin and collagen (Ex. Stevens-Johnson syndrome, psoriasis), eyes (Ex. optic neuritis, uveitis or iritis), respiratory tract (Ex. asthma, pneumonitis, tuberculosis), blood and lymph (Ex. leukaemia, anemia, thrombocytopenia, blood cancer, lymph cancer, sarcoidosis), bowel and gut (Ex. Crohn’s disease and ulcerative colitis), brain (Ex. tuberculous meningitis, cerebral edema associated with brain tumor, increased pressure within the skull) and heart (inflammation of heart membranes).

It is also indicated in the management of drug induced hypersensitivity reactions and in other allergic reactions (such as atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis and allergic rhinitis). It also corrects calcium levels among cancer patients and increases urine output or reduces protein loss via urine among patients having kidney problems (such as nephrotic syndrome).

Before receiving DEXAMETHASONE(LIFE) INJECTION inform your doctor if you any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension, glaucoma, epilepsy, underactive thyroid, muscle problems, osteoporosis, stomach problems, tuberculosis, depression, mania or any other mental problems as a precaution.

DEXAMETHASONE(LIFE) INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with serious unmanageed infections in the body or bone problems. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women.

The most common side effects of receiving DEXAMETHASONE(LIFE) INJECTION are headache, dizziness, acne, stomach discomfort, slow wound healing, skin thinning, high blood pressure, fluid retention, swelling and weight gain of the body and face, high blood sugar levels, muscle weakness, bone thinning and irregular menstrual periods. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About DECMAX 4MG TABLET

DECMAX 4MG TABLET contains Dexamethasone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids. It is used to manage problematic conditions of the adrenal glands (such as adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia and nonsuppurative thyroiditis)

It can also be used to manage various inflammatory auto-immune disease conditions affecting the bones and joints (Ex. rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis), skin and collagen (Ex. Stevens-Johnson syndrome, psoriasis), eyes (Ex. optic neuritis, uveitis or iritis), respiratory tract (Ex. asthma, pneumonitis, tuberculosis), blood and lymph (Ex. leukaemia, anemia, thrombocytopenia, blood cancer, lymph cancer, sarcoidosis), bowel and gut (Ex. Crohn’s disease and ulcerative colitis), brain (Ex. tuberculous meningitis, cerebral edema associated with brain tumor) and heart (inflammation of heart membranes)

It is also indicated in the management of drug induced hypersensitivity reactions and in other allergic reactions (such as atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis and allergic rhinitis). It also corrects calcium levels among cancer patients and increases urine output or reduces protein loss via urine among patients having kidney problems (such as nephrotic syndrome).

Before taking DECMAX 4MG TABLET inform your doctor if you any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension, glaucoma, epilepsy, underactive thyroid, muscle problems, osteoporosis, stomach problems, tuberculosis, depression, mania or any other mental problems as a precaution.

DECMAX 4MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with serious unmanageed fungal or viral infections in the body. Do not take DECMAX 4MG TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking DECMAX 4MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, acne, stomach discomfort, slow wound healing, skin thinning, high blood pressure, fluid retention, swelling and weight gain of the body and face, high blood sugar levels, muscle weakness, bone thinning and irregular menstrual periods. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How DECMAX 4MG TABLET Works

DECMAX 4MG TABLET is a steroid medicine with anti-inflammatory and immune suppressant properties. It boosts your body with sufficient corticosteroid levels (cortisol, aldosterone) during deficient conditions and helps your body to function properly.

It also reduces the release of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes inflammation, pain, irritation and swelling. As a result, it reduces allergic and inflammatory conditions in the body.
usageDetails:
How to use DECMAX 4MG TABLET

Take DECMAX 4MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It must be taken with or just after meals to manage stomach upset.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking DECMAX 4MG TABLET without consulting your doctor.

mechanismOfAction:
How DEXARIL 4MG INJECTION Works

DEXARIL 4MG INJECTION is a steroid medicine with anti-inflammatory and immune suppressant properties. It boosts your body with sufficient corticosteroid levels (cortisol, aldosterone) during deficient conditions and helps your body to function properly.

Have any bone or joint problems

Have fits

Have stomach ulcer or other serious stomach or intestinal problems

Have had stroke or any unusual stress

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before receiving DEXARIL 4MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines such as:

Aminoglutethimide or cyclophosphamide (used for managing cancer)
Anticoagulants (used for blood thinning) such as acenocoumarol, phenindione and warfarin
Medicines used to manage bacterial infections (Ex. isoniazid, erythromycin, clarithromycin and troleandomycin)
Medicines used to manage diabetes (Ex. metformin, glipizide)
Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory medicines (used for fever and pain relief) such as aspirin, ibuprofen
Medicines used to manage epilepsy (such as carbamazepine, phenytoin and primidone)
Ephedrine (used for cough)
Medicines used to manage HIV infections such as ritonavir, cobicistat
Medicines used to manage fungal infection (such as ketoconazole, amphotericin B, itraconazole)
Diuretics (used to manage edema and hypertension) Ex. furosemide, chlorothiazide, hydrochlorothiazide
Rifampicin and rifabutin (used to manage tuberculosis)
Carbenoxolone (used to manage mouth ulcer)
Anti-cholinergic medicines used to manage myasthenia gravis (such as distigmine and neostigmine)
Acetazolamide (a medicine used to manage glaucoma or edema)

Overdosage:

DEXARIL 4MG INJECTION will be administered to you only by a doctor or a nurse in a hospital and so it is unlikely to receive an overdose. However, consult your doctor or nurse if you experience any unusual symptoms.

introduction:
Introduction About ALBISONE 100 INJECTION

ALBISONE 100 INJECTION contains Hydrocortisone, which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids. ALBISONE 100 INJECTION is used to manage endocrine disorders (diseases of endocrine glands), rheumatic disorders (inflammatory and autoimmune diseases), and hematologic disorders (blood disorders) in affected individuals.

It is also used to manage collagen diseases (autoimmune disease), dermatologic diseases, ophthalmic diseases, gastrointestinal diseases, respiratory diseases, and neoplastic diseases. The medicine is also indicated for use to replace insufficient corticosteroid hormone and manage edematous and allergic states and medical emergencies (such as shock or severe allergic reactions) in affected individuals.

ALBISONE 100 INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to hydrocortisone. It is also not recommended for use in patients with systemic fungal infections, viral infections (such as herpes simplex eye infection, vaccinia, varicella), and idiopathic thrombocytopenic purpura (a blood disorder marked by low platelet levels). The medicine is also not indicated for use in patients who have recently received live-attenuated vaccines.

Before receiving ALBISONE 100 INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have/have had an infection (such as herpes simplex, chickenpox, tuberculosis, threadworm), bleeding/clotting problem, suffering from osteoporosis (brittle bone), high blood pressure, oedema (swelling in arms/legs), diabetes, kidney problems (such as renal insufficiency), and/or liver problems (such as cirrhosis).

ALBISONE 100 INJECTION should be administered with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.

ALBISONE 100 INJECTION should be administered with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). If the medicine is to be received for a longer period of time, then frequent tests on the child need to be conducted to manage the risk of developing high intracranial pressure in the child. The medicine is advised to be administered with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects associated with the use of ALBISONE 100 INJECTION are pain and swelling at the site of injection. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

ALBISONE 100 INJECTION works by replacing insufficient cortisol (naturally produced steroid) levels and blocks the production of certain chemical messengers (responsible for inflammation and allergies) in the body, which results in decreased swelling and provides relief from inflammation and pain in affected individuals.

introduction:
Introduction About MAXXLONE 4 TABLET

MAXXLONE 4 TABLET is used to manage various adrenal gland problems, including adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia, and nonsuppurative thyroiditis. It is also effective in managing autoimmune and inflammatory conditions affecting different parts of the body, such as rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, systemic lupus erythematosus, psoriasis, optic neuritis, uveitis, asthma, and certain blood disorders like leukemia. Additionally, it helps manage inflammatory bowel diseases like Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, as well as tuberculous meningitis in the brain.

This medication is also prescribed for managing severe allergic reactions, including drug-induced hypersensitivity, atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis, and allergic rhinitis. It can prevent graft rejection after organ transplantation and support kidney health by reducing protein loss in the urine or increasing urine output in conditions like nephrotic syndrome.

It contains a medicine called Methylprednisolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids.

Take MAXXLONE 4 TABLET as advised by your physician. Do not stop taking MAXXLONE 4 TABLET or reduce the dose of methylprednisolone without consulting your doctor as it may lead to unpleasant withdrawal symptoms, especially if you are taking higher dose of methylprednisolone.

Before taking MAXXLONE 4 TABLET inform your doctor if you any viral infections, or any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have hypertension, diabetes, thyroid deficiency, glaucoma, skin problem, gut inflammation, muscle problems, osteoporosis, any types of tumors or cancer in the body, depression or any other forms of mental illness.

It should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while taking MAXXLONE 4 TABLET as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of taking MAXXLONE 4 TABLET are high blood pressure, swelling of body parts, muscle cramps or weakness, skin thinning, feeling sad or depressed and slowed growth in children. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience severe depression with suicidal thoughts or severe stomach pain with blood-stained stools or vomit.

It also reduces the release of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes inflammation. It manages graft rejection by suppressing the immune functions and protects your kidney from damage in patients with kidney problems.

introduction:
Introduction About METHNIPRED 4 TABLET

METHNIPRED 4 TABLET is used to manage various adrenal gland problems, including adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia, and nonsuppurative thyroiditis. It is also effective in managing autoimmune and inflammatory conditions affecting different parts of the body, such as rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, systemic lupus erythematosus, psoriasis, optic neuritis, uveitis, asthma, and certain blood disorders like leukemia. Additionally, it helps manage inflammatory bowel diseases like Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, as well as tuberculous meningitis in the brain.

This medication is also prescribed for managing severe allergic reactions, including drug-induced hypersensitivity, atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis, and allergic rhinitis. It can prevent graft rejection after organ transplantation and support kidney health by reducing protein loss in the urine or increasing urine output in conditions like nephrotic syndrome.

It contains a medicine called Methylprednisolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids.

Take METHNIPRED 4 TABLET as advised by your physician. Do not stop taking METHNIPRED 4 TABLET or reduce the dose of methylprednisolone without consulting your doctor as it may lead to unpleasant withdrawal symptoms, especially if you are taking higher dose of methylprednisolone.

Before taking METHNIPRED 4 TABLET inform your doctor if you any viral infections, or any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have hypertension, diabetes, thyroid deficiency, glaucoma, skin problem, gut inflammation, muscle problems, osteoporosis, any types of tumors or cancer in the body, depression or any other forms of mental illness.

It should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while taking METHNIPRED 4 TABLET as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of taking METHNIPRED 4 TABLET are high blood pressure, swelling of body parts, muscle cramps or weakness, skin thinning, feeling sad or depressed and slowed growth in children. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience severe depression with suicidal thoughts or severe stomach pain with blood-stained stools or vomit.

mechanismOfAction:
How METHNIPRED 4 TABLET Works

METHNIPRED 4 TABLET is a corticosteroid medicine with anti-inflammatory and immune suppressant properties. It boosts your body with sufficient corticosteroid levels (cortisol, aldosterone) during deficient conditions and helps your body to function properly.

It also reduces the release of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes inflammation. It manages graft rejection by suppressing the immune functions and protects your kidney from damage in patients with kidney problems.

introduction:
Introduction About DEXALAB 4MG INJECTION

DEXALAB 4MG INJECTION contains Dexamethasone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids. It is used to manage problematic conditions of the adrenal glands (such as adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia and nonsuppurative thyroiditis).

It can also be used to manage various inflammatory auto-immune disease conditions affecting the bones and joints (Ex. rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis), skin and collagen (Ex. Stevens-Johnson syndrome, psoriasis), eyes (Ex. optic neuritis, uveitis or iritis), respiratory tract (Ex. asthma, pneumonitis, tuberculosis), blood and lymph (Ex. leukaemia, anemia, thrombocytopenia, blood cancer, lymph cancer, sarcoidosis), bowel and gut (Ex. Crohn’s disease and ulcerative colitis), brain (Ex. tuberculous meningitis, cerebral edema associated with brain tumor, increased pressure within the skull) and heart (inflammation of heart membranes).

It is also indicated in the management of drug induced hypersensitivity reactions and in other allergic reactions (such as atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis and allergic rhinitis). It also corrects calcium levels among cancer patients and increases urine output or reduces protein loss via urine among patients having kidney problems (such as nephrotic syndrome).

Before receiving DEXALAB 4MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension, glaucoma, epilepsy, underactive thyroid, muscle problems, osteoporosis, stomach problems, tuberculosis, depression, mania or any other mental problems as a precaution.

DEXALAB 4MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with serious unmanageed infections in the body or bone problems. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women.

The most common side effects of receiving DEXALAB 4MG INJECTION are headache, dizziness, acne, stomach discomfort, slow wound healing, skin thinning, high blood pressure, fluid retention, swelling and weight gain of the body and face, high blood sugar levels, muscle weakness, bone thinning and irregular menstrual periods. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

Have any bone or joint problems

Have had stroke or any unusual stress

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before receiving DEXALAB 4MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines such as:

Aminoglutethimide or cyclophosphamide (used for managing cancer)
Anticoagulants (used for blood thinning) such as acenocoumarol, phenindione and warfarin
Medicines used to manage bacterial infections (Ex. isoniazid, erythromycin, clarithromycin and troleandomycin)
Medicines used to manage diabetes (Ex. metformin, glipizide)
Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory medicines (used for fever and pain relief) such as aspirin, ibuprofen
Medicines used to manage epilepsy (such as carbamazepine, phenytoin and primidone)
Ephedrine (used for cough)
Medicines used to manage HIV infections such as ritonavir, cobicistat
Medicines used to manage fungal infection (such as ketoconazole, amphotericin B, itraconazole)
Diuretics (used to manage edema and hypertension) Ex. furosemide, chlorothiazide, hydrochlorothiazide
Rifampicin and rifabutin (used to manage tuberculosis)
Carbenoxolone (used to manage mouth ulcer)
Anti-cholinergic medicines used to manage myasthenia gravis (such as distigmine and neostigmine)
Acetazolamide (a medicine used to manage glaucoma or edema)

DEXALAB 4MG INJECTION will be administered to you only by a doctor or a nurse in a hospital and so it is unlikely to receive an overdose. However, consult your doctor or nurse if you experience any unusual symptoms.

introduction:
Introduction About SIODEXA INJECTION

SIODEXA INJECTION contains Dexamethasone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids. It is used to manage problematic conditions of the adrenal glands (such as adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia and nonsuppurative thyroiditis).

It can also be used to manage various inflammatory auto-immune disease conditions affecting the bones and joints (Ex. rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis), skin and collagen (Ex. Stevens-Johnson syndrome, psoriasis), eyes (Ex. optic neuritis, uveitis or iritis), respiratory tract (Ex. asthma, pneumonitis, tuberculosis), blood and lymph (Ex. leukaemia, anemia, thrombocytopenia, blood cancer, lymph cancer, sarcoidosis), bowel and gut (Ex. Crohn’s disease and ulcerative colitis), brain (Ex. tuberculous meningitis, cerebral edema associated with brain tumor, increased pressure within the skull) and heart (inflammation of heart membranes).

It is also indicated in the management of drug induced hypersensitivity reactions and in other allergic reactions (such as atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis and allergic rhinitis). It also corrects calcium levels among cancer patients and increases urine output or reduces protein loss via urine among patients having kidney problems (such as nephrotic syndrome).

Before receiving SIODEXA INJECTION inform your doctor if you any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension, glaucoma, epilepsy, underactive thyroid, muscle problems, osteoporosis, stomach problems, tuberculosis, depression, mania or any other mental problems as a precaution.

SIODEXA INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with serious unmanageed infections in the body or bone problems. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women.

The most common side effects of receiving SIODEXA INJECTION are headache, dizziness, acne, stomach discomfort, slow wound healing, skin thinning, high blood pressure, fluid retention, swelling and weight gain of the body and face, high blood sugar levels, muscle weakness, bone thinning and irregular menstrual periods. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About ITISOLON M 40 INJECTION

ITISOLON M 40 INJECTION is used to manage various adrenal gland problems, including adrenal insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia, and nonsuppurative thyroiditis. It is also effective in managing autoimmune and inflammatory conditions affecting different parts of the body, such as rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, systemic lupus erythematosus, psoriasis, optic neuritis, uveitis, asthma, and certain blood disorders like leukemia. Additionally, it helps manage inflammatory bowel diseases like Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, as well as tuberculous meningitis in the brain.

This medication is also prescribed for managing severe allergic reactions, including drug-induced hypersensitivity, atopic dermatitis, allergic conjunctivitis, and allergic rhinitis. It can prevent graft rejection after organ transplantation and support kidney health by reducing protein loss in the urine or increasing urine output in conditions like nephrotic syndrome.

It contains Methylprednisolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids.

Before receiving ITISOLON M 40 INJECTION inform your doctor if you any viral infections, or any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have hypertension, diabetes, thyroid deficiency, glaucoma, skin problem, gut inflammation, muscle problems, osteoporosis, any types of tumors or cancer in the body, depression or any other forms of mental illness.

ITISOLON M 40 INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe fungal infections, brain swelling due to malaria, or brain injury or stroke. It should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Avoid drinking grapefruit juice or eating grapefruit while receiving ITISOLON M 40 INJECTION as it may lead to unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of receiving ITISOLON M 40 INJECTION are high blood pressure, swelling of body parts, muscle cramps or weakness, skin thinning, feeling sad or depressed and slowed growth in children. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

You must also inform your doctor if you experience severe depression with suicidal thoughts or severe stomach pain with blood-stained stools or vomit after receiving it.

mechanismOfAction:
How ITISOLON M 40 INJECTION Works

ITISOLON M 40 INJECTION is a corticosteroid medicine with anti-inflammatory and immune suppressant properties. It boosts your body with sufficient corticosteroid levels (cortisol, aldosterone) during deficient conditions and helps your body to function properly.

It also reduces the release of certain chemicals (prostaglandins) in the body that causes pain, swelling and inflammation. It manages graft rejection by suppressing the immune functions and protects your kidney from damage in patients with kidney problems.

Introduction About HEADON 4IU INJECTION

HEADON 4IU INJECTION contains Somatropin which belongs to the group of medicines called Growth hormone agonists. It is used in children with growth failure due to growth hormone deficiency (GHD), idiopathic short stature (ISS), Turner syndrome (TS), Prader-Willi Syndrome, are too small or light at birth and in chronic kidney disease (CKD).

In adults it is used to manage either childhood-onset or adult-onset GHD. Growth hormone deficiency (GHD) is also called dwarfism or pituitary dwarfism. It is a disease characterized by low growth hormone levels in the body.

Your doctor might want you to take certain tests and follow a particular diet during management with HEADON 4IU INJECTION. HEADON 4IU INJECTION is not recommended for use if you have an active cancer, are seriously ill (like you need to get a surgery done) or if your growth has already stopped.

Before receiving HEADON 4IU INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have myalgia, diabetes, kidney or thyroid problem. HEADON 4IU INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women and caution should be exercised while using it in breastfeeding women.

It should be used with caution in elderly patients above 80 years of age. The most common side effects of receiving HEADON 4IU INJECTION are joint pain, water retention (which shows as puffy fingers or swollen ankles), injection site reaction. Contact your physician for advice if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About OVUNAL SC 10000IU INJECTION

OVUNAL SC 10000IU INJECTION contains Chorionic gonadotropin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Gonadotropins. It is used to manage hypogonadism (deficiency of sex hormones) in men. It also helps in the release of matured ovum (eggs) from the ovaries (ovulation) among infertile women after undergoing premanagement with suitable hormonal medicines (such as menotropins or FSH).

It also helps in sustaining pregnancy during the early stages among women who experience habitual abortions. It can also be used in the management of prepubertal cryptorchidism (failure of testis to descend into the scrotum) caused by hormone deficiency in young male children (aged between 4 and 9 years).

During management with OVUNAL SC 10000IU INJECTION, your doctor would monitor your health condition through several blood tests and ultrasounds to avoid the risk of side effects like fluid accumulation, abnormally enlarged ovarian follicles, or multiple pregnancies (pregnant with more than one child), especially if you are undergoing assisted reproductive techniques.

Before receiving OVUNAL SC 10000IU INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have any forms of cancer in the ovaries, uterus, breasts, or prostate. You must also inform your doctor if you have any damage in the fallopian tubes, as management with OVUNAL SC 10000IU INJECTION may cause ectopic pregnancy (pregnancy outside of the womb) in such cases.

OVUNAL SC 10000IU INJECTION may cause a false positive pregnancy result in women who take a pregnancy test using their blood or urine. This effect may last up to 10 days even after discontinuing management with OVUNAL SC 10000IU INJECTION.

OVUNAL SC 10000IU INJECTION may be used to sustain pregnancy during the initial stages (luteal phase). However, it should not be used in the later stages of pregnancy. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.

The most common side effects of OVUNAL SC 10000IU INJECTION are reaching puberty at an early age, pain at the injection site, headaches, and irritability. Consult your doctor if they worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How OVUNAL SC 10000IU INJECTION Works

OVUNAL SC 10000IU INJECTION is a gonadotrophic hormone that stimulates the production of sex hormones in both men and women. In men, it acts by stimulating the release of androgens, which are responsible for the development of secondary sexual characteristics and for regulating the onset of puberty. It also helps to move down the testicles into the scrotum in children having undescended testis.

In women, it triggers the release of mature eggs from the ovaries and helps to sustain pregnancy by supplementing enough female sex hormones (estrogen and progesterone), which are required for maintaining a successful conception.
